She was the deciding vote on Trump’s tax cuts for billionaires back in 2017. Less than a year later, she was a pivotal vote in Brett Kavanaugh’s confirmation to the Supreme Court. As a Spokane Deputy Prosecutor, I held sexual abusers, drunk drivers, and violent offenders accountable.

I've raised more than anyone else challenging Baumgartner - _overwhelmingly from grassroots donors right here in Eastern Washington.

I'm writing to ask for $3.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In case it wasn’t bad enough that Do-Nothing Democrat Rep. Wesley Bell is
propped up by millions of dollars from AIPAC and corporate super PACs — it
turns out his campaign manager has been attending a white supremacist
event for years.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-2-cb.o6ov0J&refcode=em20260730-38104&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38104%2E1203867%2E6BdANR ]A screenshot of a post on x from Ryan Grim (@ryangrim) reading: 'This
is absolutely wild: Wesley Bell's campaign manager has been attending the
Veiled Prophet ball for years. Notorious event.' below which is a
screenshot of a Facebook post from Khalea Edwards that reads, 'Turns out
Wesley Bells campaign manager is in the Veiled Prophet. Her & her family
have been attending their white supremacists ball for decades. She got a
whole album on her Facebook called 'Veiled Prophet Ball' & there are
photos of her dad going year after year. This the same secret society
actress Ellie Kemper was cancelled for in 2021 after being crowned their
'KKK Princess.' She publically apologized, admitting the Veiled Prophet is
'unquestionably racist, elitist, & sexist.'' alongside two photos from a
ball event.

The Veiled Prophet Ball is an infamous whites-only debutante ball that’s
taken place in St. Louis since 1878. Not only has Bell’s campaign manager
repeatedly attended it, she even worked for Trudy Busch Valentine, who was
crowned queen of this racist ball.

We can’t say we’re surprised. Bell himself previously worked as a campaign
manager for a Republican before deciding to run for Congress as a
Democrat, and to this day he receives financial support from Trump
megadonors.

Missouri’s first district deserves a real Democrat representing them in
Congress, one who isn’t bought by the pro-Israel lobby, corporate PACs,
and MAGA billionaires.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-2-cb.o6ov0J&refcode=em20260730-38104&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38104%2E1203867%2E6BdANR ]Help progressive champion Cori Bush take back this seat from Bell and
the far-right interests backing him on Tuesday: rush a split contribution
of $10 or more to her campaign and Justice Democrats before
tomorrow’s July deadline!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-2-cb.o6ov0J&refcode=em20260730-38104&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=38104%2E1203867%2E6BdANR ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

If you had told me a few years ago when I was working at my auto-repair shop that Fox News would write an article praising one of my legislative pushes, I probably would have laughed.
Well, wonders never cease:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Look, I’ve honestly never cared about partisan politics or playing games for D.C. cable networks. I’m just interested in fixing what’s broken, restoring basic accountability, and making sure the people representing us are doing their job.
That’s why I pushed for common-sense accountability standards for members of Congress who might be suffering from significant, irreversible cognitive impairment. In every real-world job I’ve ever had, there’s a pretty simple expectation: you actually have to be able to do the work. Either you can do it or you can't. Congress shouldn't be any different.
And I’m proud to be fighting for issues that so many Americans care about — regardless of party lines.
But the big national partisan donors aren't going to fund a campaign like mine that refuses to play by D.C.'s hyper-partisan rules. That means I rely entirely on independent, grassroots supporters like you to keep me in Congress.

subject: Please help before the July 31st deadline. I’m $4865 from reaching my July fundraising goal!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bayudan for Council 2026
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tony-bayudan-1

| | | | | [|

| | | | | |
Dear Friends,Please help before the July 31st deadline. I’m $4865 from reaching my July fundraising goal!This campaign is built on one simple principle: local government should provide **opportunity for all.** Today, families across our city are feeling the squeeze of rising housing, healthcare, and grocery costs. Young families wonder if they can afford to stay, and seniors worry about being priced out. Working people deserve a City Hall focused on making life more affordable while protecting the unique quality of life that makes Daly City so special.As a lifelong resident and the proud son of working-class Filipino immigrants, these challenges are personal. My family has called Daly City home since 1977, when my parents bought our home at the Top of the Hill. I attended our local schools and learned the values of hard work, service, and looking out for your neighbors.My career has been dedicated to serving this community. For the past ten years, I’ve served as Chief of Staff to San Mateo County Supervisor David J. Canepa. As Vice Chair of Daly City's Personnel Board, I’ve also gained firsthand experience in making local government more responsive and accountable. I know how to navigate government, build partnerships, and bring resources home because I’ve spent my career doing exactly that.If elected, I will focus on delivering real results that provides opportunity for all:
* [**Affordability:** Improving housing affordability, expanding healthcare access, and helping families keep up with the cost of living.](https://us.list-manage.com/eniqUTCVSYJ?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
* [**Public Safety & Infrastructure:** Investing in first responders, fixing flooding challenges, repairing potholes, and strengthening transit options.](https://us.list-manage.com/REe2IjIpvnS?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
* [**Family Support:** Advocating for a childcare center at Daly City Hall to support working parents and make city services more accessible.](https://us.list-manage.com/18pIdVzerLk?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
* [**Senior Care:** Protecting and expanding programs that help seniors age safely and independently in their homes.](https://us.list-manage.com/10w77LT_niJ?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)

**I’m ready to step into a leadership role myself in every way but I can’t do it without you. As I know from helping to run Supervisor Canepa’s campaigns and you probably do too, campaigns are not cheap.**[**Can you be one of my founding donors?**](https://us.list-manage.com/8VYmGRHdCHM?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)**Nothing is more important to a campaign than early money, as it helps us get off to a fast start and build a winning campaign from the get-go.**
[**Could you donate today in any amount up to $5,900? $1,000, $500, $100 or even $25 will make a huge difference to my campaign at this early stage.**](https://us.list-manage.com/2Xdv4NZo7yk?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
Our city has always been defined by hardworking families, diverse neighborhoods, and neighbors who care about one another. Together, we can build a Daly City that is more affordable, safer, better prepared for the future, and continues to be a place where families of every generation can thrive – a Daly City that truly provides opportunity for all.I would be honored to earn your support, your ideas, and your vote.In friendship,
Tony BayudanCandidate for Daly City Council**P.S. Anything you can donate today at**[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tony-bayudan-1**](https://us.list-manage.com/qXYchUOFvxY?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)**will be so valuable – even if it’s just $5!**

# **[BRONCO BUSTED: I caught Ford sneaking my data — and uncovered an even bigger threat](http://trk.libertyledger._c2V5aWQ9In0/Kd6J5j_h9NFr7Y1uZ07IoQ)**
---
Last night my Ford Bronco installed an automatic software update. By the next morning, it had quietly opted me into sharing additional driving data without asking my permission.Fortunately, I caught the change before heading out and turned it back off. But instead of simply being annoyed by another software update, I found myself asking some much bigger questions: Why does Ford need more information about how I drive? Who benefits from collecting it? And why can a vehicle I already own change my privacy settings without my approval?Manufacturers can collect your vehicle's data, transmit it wirelessly, analyze it, and in many cases monetize it.That update made me realize I'd been covering the same story under different headlines.

name: Houston Gaines
subject: What a Year It’s Been—Thank You!
body:
A few favorite moments from the past year—and a look at what’s ahead
| | | | |
---
| One year ago today, we officially kicked off our campaign for Congress. I wanted to take a moment to simply say thank you for your incredible support from day one.
Over the past 365 days, so many of you have poured your time, resources, and heart into this effort. You knocked on doors across the district, waved signs on busy street corners, made phone calls, attended events, contributed financially, shared our message with friends and family, and encouraged others to get involved.
Because of your help, we won a hard-fought primary in May. Now, as we enter the final months of this race, I am confident in our path forward because of the strength of our supporters. We have accomplished a great deal together, but there is still important work ahead: winning the general election and then, most importantly, getting to work in Washington.
Below, I've included a few of my favorite photos from the past year--from our campaign kickoff and qualifying to primary election night, with dozens of events and more than a hundred stops across the district in between.
Thank you for believing in our campaign, for standing with us, and most of all, for your friendship. Please never hesitate to call on me if I can ever be of service.
Your friend, Houston

| | Friends,
Earlier this week, the Michigan Supreme Court made an outrageous ruling that will put the lives of Michiganders in danger. In a 5-1 decision, these radical politicians ruled certain life without parole sentences were unconstitutional and ruled these dangerous criminals must be considered eligible to be released.
---
| | [](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001WBKcLS2JoGj6IMGxVoTRHfpjFwK6vPuNc_n0OC4W-VVkuIvaW11eA_hQw3Nlb-VnwEU59LbDcdHQuv3nJhzhBzszbgFMfZy3FLl8NBb3xLFMfyavr285su65MNI9jGRXJME1hdJ23xnmnKe5vaypku0bdjpoHbkoDuVffrtJTY1qEtEu2TiReFGgCbTv515z&c=DWaysSdt9jBmZ6NVUGKjlyYgyxpbOXPzqZKVySz1lXNqqoagkVPEZQ==&ch=7lpHveSu86_XBPjNWqIjadrY8vQHmMmHHglrqZbf4l3562n787e_Kg==)

Murderers could soon return to our streets because the Court once again chose to legislate from the bench.
This is yet another ruling this Court has made that makes our state less safe. Just last year, the Court also struck down hundreds of life without parole sentences for 19 and 20 year-olds who were convicted of murder.
When I see rulings like this, I immediately start thinking about the victims and families whose lives were changed by these criminals. It is unconscionable that any public servant would side with criminals over them, but that is exactly what Michigan's Supreme Court continues to do. I have spent my career standing up for victims and I will continue to do so when I am Attorney General.
But what should frighten everyone is the prospect of Eli Savit being Attorney General and working with this court to create catastrophic damage to Michigan.
As county prosecutor, my opponent has ended cash bail, legalized prostitution and hallucinogenic drugs, and allowed violent criminals to get off easy only for them to commit more violence in our communities.
The safety of Michiganders hangs in the balance in this race. Lives will be at risk if my opponent and this Supreme Court team up. I hope you will work with me to win this race and elect Judge Casandra Morse-Bills and Judge Michael Warren to the Supreme Court to prevent a nightmare from becoming a reality.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

name: Defend Our Courts
subject: Trump begs SCOTUS to save his presidency
body:
Someone get these beggars out of here.
| | | | If you believe you've received this email in error, you may unsubscribe below.
---
---
---
| | [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gs0QJPp79G1CxaxVc0zWstg3RsF4QK-wQRT6g3lsUmz9nLowlMAq9wPil5bmf7_r8bRLG9ZKu8-Gncx5jiDA8XEsm3AmEn1c-JKFYXMeSb3_fRHodGAh_ieXNFpp5Tup8OMXYOoGmaLsj5HISE3aX0U7t-ofE3R6T_ww9v_gCd5WP68pzeWnBZfuDEJ8teRqj6JUn7oEIzaS2UveWG2ce1pSfvN_ARLbBamWUEU1Dlw9a2iYN-ByMcBws6KKvnVE&c=7GI_SRRHRXBQ_3rI3YzR4tpKG1suuncGPCLzUSYO-717lySF2nLYHw==&ch=BaEpj6BxU3kc_vwExRooddX9Lmi6GBazZEyOyWIbNyZGVB5DJ2EVIw==)
---
| Friend,
---
| _Trump won’t stop begging._ On Monday, the Trump administration marched into the Supreme Court and pleaded to the justices to let him gut mail-in voting before the November election.
---
| **It's the same demented obsession that has consumed this man since 2020 repackaged for the dozenth time:** an executive order that would let the federal government decide who gets a mail ballot, by forcing the Postal Service to mail ballots only to voters whose names appear on "citizenship lists" compiled by his very own administration.
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gs0QJPp79G1CxaxVc0zWstg3RsF4QK-wQRT6g3lsUmz9nLowlMAq9wPil5bmf7_rHQ9LHhoH3LDpvX4Dv0PvmyDqOS5TVfW_Qkm5SOaID9-zL-_0iq1pB7SLMcYWuncztFAvzvgA7wXg94l-XodYecRp1jdO_pPCAw8ZxnI0UyJsi3oVBjF054sBCGravNWO-KrNQc3gFn7J6ePdjhW_Ns46jHK15iX9TjH40Fvgxaz3uD5ARci43YgNGhNv3VE5&c=7GI_SRRHRXBQ_3rI3YzR4tpKG1suuncGPCLzUSYO-717lySF2nLYHw==&ch=BaEpj6BxU3kc_vwExRooddX9Lmi6GBazZEyOyWIbNyZGVB5DJ2EVIw==)
---
| **This is the move of a pathetic loser, a man so terrified of being held accountable for the disaster he's made of America and the world, and so unable to accept he's headed for a blowout, that he'd rather beg nine unelected judges to rig the game than face the voters.**
---
| _Every_ court has told him he can’t do this. A federal judge blocked it; the 1st Circuit upheld that block, warning it would "threaten disenfranchisement of many eligible voters." The Constitution gives states and Congress the power to run elections, _not the president._
---
| _Yet he just keeps begging._
---
| **But there is something that is actually alarming about this latest attempt.** This time he filed an emergency application, inviting SCOUTS to issue a ruling using the _“shadow docket”_ , where it can hand him a win with no signed opinion, no reasoning to scrutinize, and no precedent that could ever be used against MAGA later.
---
| _We have all seen how this Court rules._ They overturned Roe. They gutted the Voting Rights Act. They handed Trump criminal immunity. This court has been fully exposed as a puppet of Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to torch a half-century of precedent to tilt elections their way.
---
| So ask yourself: do you trust this Supreme Court to stop Trump from banning voting by mail Trump from weaponizing voter data against Democrats? _Neither do we._
---
| _**This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists.**_ We are fighting on two fronts. First, building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections state by state. Second, building the movement to reclaim a Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.

## Trump May Pull Blanche Nomination for AG
President Trump said Thursday he may [temporarily withdraw Todd Blanche's nomination](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ_GdF75bzEULiJFdF-ULiUa7AGcGM_KzO6Kt482r5D6SlfnnF9f8xfkkuv2Aw4MvNJc8X0WZMY2w1bpyBU4U6W6U0lvaiXF52yU6aXy0uo5QS7X7LoUVkSDtsOg_XB3o-m16fYAy10PanU-9kv0OPYAgMkmn3Cww2q6HD5vylutlVZqvK1jWq2OYDUMfnSjcApTZmq335Qr77iWi17YbpGOroSd-XEK-02YSZgJlvgx-GzCTD-pZM7xFGba6HHKSK1eVUaqnOsTT7kUin8kU0pyKVDjjhKYqVW85IYVGxRhppOpXcJOOQn7Xdu7MYMbXddCerxzKfnsvXBqOyCXf1D8XyVfwfwNAAD__90aibw) for attorney general and resubmit it after two Republican senators blocking him leave office in January. Sens. John Cornyn of Texas and Thom Tillis of North Carolina want the Justice Department to guarantee in writing that a $1.8 billion fund tied to Trump's tax settlement is [permanently dead](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLvO4yAUhJ8GOiIuNpiCYht32XZLC5tDOCsuESGJ8vYrp9kH-MvRSN_omz_X7eoxY7399gXciG2r8H5kGAP65m-1Fax-YKutppbDu_UcjucmudSMG6bEFjzmzzbR4CKABEXBCbPMk5VaSJrc7I2Z9qhD1HaPcd53sRttjI7LorkCiu6kcaOE4IJze4k2RCUOr4RfjJ0smTgEHK1f_jasI0HMn_aCfjlaodmlMe4Pon4RuRK5jgQJcz47ItfUCpxCRK4-FKz4GP2rQ-Q6W2uNFWz0Z7mzPft6JGD_jdnRev1UNjBnPAm0u3B_f5M2ZOK34vE7RMePnns5-S8AAP__-DSEXQ). That settlement also barred the IRS from auditing the family's past tax returns. The Senate Judiciary Committee [scrapped Thursday's vote](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unDAQBeCnMZ1X_mEXKFykobtpU6LBHoOjwYOMWXTfPmKbPMCtphjp6Jzvz9f0BYlSXn7Dhq5GnjJeB2GtWCZYMm8pQ02cOa9M4eJCwZ-TUeYlVSetngIk-p7aJriIaNA26HTXP9vBvLRpVqchWN2j917PHZhX772FYdYx2mcbEZrk7jTVWa2VVmp4xCFEqz1YDX03tINoFYZUuTz-csp1xUjf_Mby8Lw15NZa90PYX8KMwozXdT3y7O8V91-YcWdKNflDmDFwBgqylnPbhRk_V9a1IFTMh9xPIlk5BDkTZL_iIWGR_w3kwru8GfishySEN0qOsvgMz0GpZ9sUF_YrEaXj1YlWLRsk-tSsP7J9O_MvAAD__924kis). With every Democrat opposed, a single Republican defection sinks the nomination. Cornyn said the two are not the only senators with concerns. Trump called both men finished politically and said Blanche stays on as acting attorney general regardless. Waiting them out [carries risk](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAUBODT4A4LHo6BguJv3OVvt7QwPNtEGCLyEiu3XyVX2HI00jfS_Fznq085le2_P9DRWueC5yMjEbbZb6UeqXhKtdSy1xzP2nIMzxkEjFxoruQcfcrveeiiWxEBVYdOanMZLIwSut1ZNMZc_BLG0SxgYBEhaK8g2mDMarBL7qMJraQUUgjbrzauSgavpDfaDpYNAmOi2vpbTYV2XPO7vrD1oR5ddjvR_cHUPwYTg-k8zz6UJXxKBtOHZjAJzWBSgsFE7Xnc-ZJ9CTtyv_FYbzzUVt6FU8o5Pfqdjtw1F-_nN4-aDWI7fMrfQfrTSy8HvwEAAP__nkV7DA), since Republicans could lose Senate seats in November.
## World Cup Deal Sparks Euro Boycott
Europe's 55 soccer associations voted unanimously on Thursday to [boycott all FIFA competitions](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6xg8G_hIo27mzalRWDYnQgzDp5dy28f-b5CuiMd6eh836-v9ctTpvL86TecJfFa8DwyimBd_bPwRsULceHy4hxPrjmG9woGem0G7ewaPeVrbZs4J0RA1-Bsh7FrJ-gtNK85GQ-D7cM4wYAxjc66znW9N9YNXQRsaL7XzOCsNdaY6ZGmmJwN3lk_DlM7qdZgJOH6-MNU5IUpX_zB-gi8NXl-ieyHcj8ULAqW8zwfeOzlLhUsB4eA9Q7C9VKwrAoWigqWdmrHsRtbBcsbk9e_-Qoson3OOlHyOvC2o9ANf-i9suAh-luADu9d75U-XlDj3zfJpffsS1PnuJ-UMx39oFrz3Dzl75fyX2o_M_wLAAD__-9ijro), including the men's and women's World Cups, over a plan to sell part of the tournament to private investors. FIFA wants to spin its commercial rights into a $20 billion company and [sell a 20% stake to outside investors](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMZ2j9ZoEXLi4hu6_9kpk8Dr4YrwIm0S8_Ym8wtUjfZqZPz_jj4sp5udvt5KtgcdMn5KoVtpH98y8xuxq5Mx54eQ_vCc_HyMCPiR0UqvRu5jOsW28DURIuiGruv7eGnwobBY7QQ9OmzsY3yvXaTBzuIdetX7SANg20V4adFopUADmFowPWs1OK9d3pjWiBfKx8n77yzHXhUI6-U37bea1SXapdStC_xI4CBzyuXGpVyRwuGCBA3QCBw0Ch-koMVMpAoeDgpOV5cTnzLXK7zQ5H5u8bIkwyddRlky7TDG_yMsQg5OeXJKFj32mS2l267dPTCmWRydaeK4upm-x-l9vvi3-CwAA___yfYhn). The lead buyer would be a firm founded by Joshua Kushner, brother of Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law. European officials called the plan irresponsible and indefensible, saying it was hatched in secret. A source close to his firm said Joshua Kushner has [no role in the Trump administration](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOpDAURL_GZEZ-0DwCB5uQzaYboot93XjG-CLbNOq_X9G_MFlJRyrVqX9fyxeEGNLzL-xoqqcl4VUi1op5gWeiPSSogRKljaK7KEdnz0UJ1XMxcC0XByG-l65xxiMq1A0aOYyPblK9VM1mhlFbrUCN6uFWCdb22K-PFUQv9CS0aIK528SgpRRSiKn1k_NaWtASxmHqJtYJdKFSbr8ppLqhj296YW4t7U00W61HYfoPUzNT83VdrV3LbXFzpuY7MjXjmelASLyQtZj5iR74Sm9LtXIfPPAj3hRj5KXCD_KPLLfnwUN6YamUC_-msp3Af86yJcxMzU027rhCjKH0A-vEc4cQP8vqr-58GfU_AAD__2cljP0) and donates only to liberal causes. A boycott would strip Germany, France, England, and reigning champion Spain from the 2030 field. FIFA's 211 members [vote in September](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCnMZ2RfwgOhYtr6HLtlWhj7wafjI1gE5S3P5FXuHqkTzPzc5tukHIqj29Y0DPVqeCxZ2TGbYJHqUsqwKmWWuaa41G3HMNzMsr0Ujlp9RQh5ffUNdETokHboNfueukG02vTzB6sjgSdgs5ZstaRRup7Y--KLj3SpUn-1JSzWiut1NDSEMnqAFbD1Q3dIDqFMXHd2t-aCs9I-V1fuLWhLk32M_O6C_slzCjMeBxHG8o9nKEw40kLMyonzGiVMOMTCSTPGwJj2eVnkAzPVd7rO1RmecqSEoFM5YU7L1hYrhlKO_OSm83H9Ug5p713olOPBVL-FOF_vffy5i8AAP__1aWEbQ).
## List: America's Top Dog Breed by State
New data shows the [most popular dog breed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OszAQAJ8GOiP_xYTCxdfQ5WuvRBu8wJ6MjewNKG9_yr3C9aMZab4e0wMoUlr_w46elzwlvGpEZiwTrCnvlIApp5y2HMOVSwzza9JSOyF7YdQUgOJ7sm3wC6JG06JX_f1mB-2UbjfvlHlK15vbgHYJKLUD6AdnrAR7cyG05D822RulpJJy6JYhLEbNYBTc-8EOjZUYiHPpvjMl3nCJ73xi6ea8t9FvzEdtzL9Gj40er-vqTqoviDMcxBCp8gds9LjDcWAQC5y5EKMIeRXPghjE8y1eoorKwNjosS0-HBfFSNX1jZXrDhR_a_ynRafXPwEAAP__Jrh7-g) in every state, and the map is more regional than anyone might guess. Eight breeds finish first somewhere in the country. Labrador retrievers lead in 16 states, more than any other breed, though that is still fewer than a third of the country. Chihuahuas follow close behind with 14 states. The clusters are striking. Labs dominate the Northeast, Chihuahuas take much of the Southwest, and American pit bull terriers lead in several Southern states. A few states break the pattern. California and Florida both prefer French bulldogs, Colorado picks Golden retrievers, and New York goes for Yorkshire terriers. The rankings come from 1.2 million dog insurance records. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service has ended [endangered species protections](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI5sQ8xSuNiGLttuiQwek5GMjTyzIdmvfyKR3g-8YqpzNbrn_r1NN48J8_rHb-D4GcuU4aAEzFCnrRD7HBJ4YvIRFmQEWitMRhkrVS9bPQWP6TV1TXCzCoNuwOn-17Ubrr3tmrtr9RJViAC2N2DDbIbBagUxqPaq56Vr0J3PVN9qrZXp9MWoMPRDjLPVdlGzF52CgFzqhe_A8PQU06s8oF6WsjXJ3Zl3Eu1vYUZhRvLZ5xVSSfiAMyHMeCp9kPwwYcZvAyXMmPxB_5DlXsu2M0nI4bwzXCFI2mFBoBMzLIwlywOI5buMTPjf19BUF_YDU0KyvejUunlM74b8s10fznwFAAD__2mVj48) for the dunes sagebrush lizard, a 2.5-inch reptile native to the Permian Basin, after Attorney General Ken Paxton sued over the designation. The reversal came in a [July 21 settlement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMhZ9G3q5A0YoVDxru4u126dDRYCzKESD_QGLi5O2LuI_QifwI4uDD-fMz_lDKaZ1_0cJeXnEbVz5qZhEu47JVoTVkpiqVIk9JEte58IiA3Re4r9aMgVJ-j7YJ_gahNw17464X219cZ5u7R-PMBP0V2bYThBAtI-E1ug7Asm2b5D9h4FpjDKA1GiH0ro_x1plughspCxySbEXLnYVfVGN-b08uetqWJvu7yF5V-61wUDgcx6HPJxLZysrvmVculPW8PRUONQlXhUPgSI8sCoeY8nlJC83nsheun_nR0uA0GoUXhN-S9kcm4fAPWSTzwquc-D0XPknvITbFh_1IOafaOWVhXijl01b-r-Onx78BAAD__2ObkHo) that vacates the 2024 classification and requires the agency to reassess the lizard's status within two years. Paxton argued the service ignored "the best scientific and commercial data" and habitat restoration efforts. "_Texas, its people, and its industries should not have to suffer the effects of an illegal rule while the Fish and Wildlife Service further evaluates the status of the species_ ," Paxton said. Conservationists say the reversal [benefits oil and gas interests](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGzpCAQhH8NZliAKGdAcInZXnqhNcrgUotgwbx19_36V-5feOHUdH_V3f9v8w1CDGn7Bztaevk8JzxrRCIs854rQXIRoVIFj2uggHUrOCuhBi4M7-TsIMT3rBtnF-FG2aCV5k-vx94MurlbY_pOiw6cH9y4eK9dr8QymFF03QJeNcFeMGE6KaVQWrZKuNGM3i-DHFaxANMCXaBcWroj4Quqj-_8xNKueW-ivRMdlXV_mZqYms7zbB9Ij-vJ1HS1YWr62JiaDnhRTjzCWb8C8aPk_aDKMTmePffosEC8TkgbFnS8HrgGrJeScKWQE_e58A-Px_ANxTE1NcW64wwxhjoYpsW2Q4ifePS7UZ9W_QQAAP__ckOPrA), with the Center for Biological Diversity accusing the agency of abandoning struggling wildlife. Oil and gas groups had warned for years that the protections would slow Permian Basin projects.

Volunteer Spotlight: Ayomide Aina
[image: image.jpeg]

“Why Helena?” Story Series

Hello, Rhode Island. My name is Ayomide Aina, and I am a senior at Boston
University studying Political Science and International Relations. Since
joining the team earlier this summer, I have seen the heart this campaign
brings to every corner of Rhode Island, whether it's hearing from
supporters while we drop off yard signs or feeling the lively energy at
local events. Every conversation has taught me something new about what
this state needs. It has been a truly rewarding summer, one that has let me
engage with Rhode Island on a civic level and witness firsthand the
tireless dedication of everyone on this team.

But what unites this team most is an unwavering belief in Helena's ability
to lead Rhode Island as governor. I've watched interns give up their
weekends driven by nothing more than a genuine belief that Rhode Island
deserves a governor that is going to ensure the State House works for
everyone. Her dedication to ensuring that every community in Rhode Island
is heard is inspiring to witness, especially as someone born and raised in
Providence. Her investment in and leadership of various nonprofits and
community organizations reflects a deep understanding of the daily needs of
Rhode Islanders, and her vision for reforming healthcare, transportation,
and the public school system truly captures the change we all hope to see.

body:
Let me explain why our campaign is a good investment.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&source=&t=1&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)

I need your help, Peter. I’m still waiting in hope that you will [**make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina before tonight’s deadline.**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&amount=5&t=9&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)
If you don’t have anything to spare, that’s OK – but if you’ve been considering it at all, give me 30 seconds to explain why this is a great way you can spend $5 today.
**I’m the Democrat with the best chance in the whole country to flip a Senate seat.** Multiple polls have now shown me in the lead – in a seat that Democrats haven’t won since 2008.
My opponent has super PACs pouring millions (nearly $100 million and counting so far) into NC to support him. But I have people like you. If we can hit our $1.5 million end-of-month goal before midnight, we can stay on track to match them. If we can’t raise that, we won’t be able to keep up.
**One of the main ways we raise money is from emails like these, and all I’m asking for is $5.[So please, if you care about flipping a Senate seat, winning in North Carolina or taking back the Democratic Senate majority, will you help us reach our goal by making your first donation of just $5?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&amount=5&t=10&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)

subject: A personal request
body:
Hello.
# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1317?t=1&akid=972%2E3892029%2EX5gwzz)

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q32026?refcode=em260731-1&refcode2=972_3892029_X5gwzz&akid=972%2E3892029%2EX5gwzz)
---
Peter,
This is Paul Eaton. My friend, Alex Vindman, is running for a seat in the United States Senate in my home state of Florida. Alex is a combat veteran who served our country for 21 years in the Army.
I can tell you this with absolute certainty: If more people like Alex ran for office, we’d be well on our way to saving this country from the likes of Trump. We cannot let this opportunity pass us by.
That’s why, with less than 100 days until the election, I am humbly asking you to make a contribution to his campaign before his July 31 fundraising deadline. If you’re ready, use this link:
[**https://act.alexvindman.com/go/Personal-Request-For-Alex-Vindman**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q32026?refcode=em260731-1&refcode2=972_3892029_X5gwzz&akid=972%2E3892029%2EX5gwzz)
While I was in the Army, I commanded the U.S. Army Infantry Center at Fort Benning. Alex is a graduate of our most elite Infantry schools, including Ranger School, Airborne and our finest leadership schools; and he was commissioned as an Infantry officer. He led American troops in combat, was wounded in action, and received the Purple Heart.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q32026?refcode=em260731-1&refcode2=972_3892029_X5gwzz&akid=972%2E3892029%2EX5gwzz)
This alone is a record of service and sacrifice worthy of recognition, but it’s likely you know of Alex for a different reason.
In 2019, while serving on the National Security Council, Alex blew the whistle on a phone call in which Donald Trump asked President Zelenskyy of Ukraine to investigate the Biden family in exchange for military aid.
**Trump went on to be impeached for that phone call, and that happened because Alex had the courage to do the right thing.**
For his courage, Alex has had to endure relentless attacks from Trump, his allies, and their extremist supporters. But it has not broken him, nor has it lessened his love for and devotion to this country.
I can personally attest to that. I have been incredibly fortunate to work with Alex for the last several years at VoteVets. I have personally witnessed his integrity, his intelligence, and his patriotism. At this perilous time in our nation’s history, I’m incredibly proud that Alex has chosen to serve — again. The true quiet professional who never walks past a mistake.
[**Today, I am humbly asking you to make a donation to his campaign for Senate before his fundraising deadline. Florida is one of the toughest states in the country, but Alex can win. But to do it, he’s going to need a lot of help — from all of us.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q32026?refcode=em260731-1&refcode2=972_3892029_X5gwzz&akid=972%2E3892029%2EX5gwzz)

Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis is one of my favorite authors, full stop.

His writings were essential in deepening my faith in God and my understanding of the Bible. Maybe, since you opened my email, he has helped you, too.

Why are Lewis's words so powerful?

It's because he was a master at addressing life's most important questions. His vivid language is delightful and captivating to read.

Lewis's signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired so many skeptics to **become** believers and even more Christians to renew and deepen their faith. He is certainly the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

To help you learn more about Lewis's works related to Christianity, we produced a powerful, free course, "**C.S. Lewis on Christianity** ," which you can now own on DVD absolutely free.

**Claim your FREE DVD set of "C.S. Lewis on Christianity" using this secure link:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-cs-lewis-christianity-dvd](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U1r3DAQBuBfI99s9LX27sGHBGehkLT0A3IUimbWOyBbQiM7zb8vW7bQc64zwzzwvq8v7sVTpHX-6hccidlBAleQsez4kbYCO7yl34zVaan7Vg6tUc6HSjs66xsYD1odL8cGRzUcD_Z0OljbXMdgEHuDKHulpNeo3nrwWtleyxAQQ0Pj7Z8cjFJaHqzuLKIc1AAnsArNEYWVWwZfsaOVCZBDSjmnSJUCd6nMTRyvtWYW5kHos9BnWi-pu1KMDD5ih7AJfb4UxDZwG_GduA3XQlzJr1Q_WthBmDMHYSYptTYPUkr1rE7Tt2l6-il0v9XFcdpKQGGmXBJnDJXW-b5aEGhbhJlw8RTvw-CX7GlehZkCu7-q-191N_V-mtaKaxVmevzy-Pzkvg_t668f7b9cmjJCfqcYiftBWDnflC6kpamfKGof9Z8AAAD__yooo50)

In this course, you will study Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* Good and evil
* Conversion and faith
* Prayer and the Bible
* Suffering and death
* Heaven and Hell

The instructor, Michael Ward, is a distinguished visiting professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He wrote _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

You'll find this course especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith. You'll even trace Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for you to grow in your knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

[So please join us in studying Christianity with C.S. Lewis and Michael Ward with this beautiful free DVD set.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U1r3DAQBuBfI99s9LX27sGHBGehkLT0A3IUimbWOyBbQiM7zb8vW7bQc64zwzzwvq8v7sVTpHX-6hccidlBAleQsez4kbYCO7yl34zVaan7Vg6tUc6HSjs66xsYD1odL8cGRzUcD_Z0OljbXMdgEHuDKHulpNeo3nrwWtleyxAQQ0Pj7Z8cjFJaHqzuLKIc1AAnsArNEYWVWwZfsaOVCZBDSjmnSJUCd6nMTRyvtWYW5kHos9BnWi-pu1KMDD5ih7AJfb4UxDZwG_GduA3XQlzJr1Q_WthBmDMHYSYptTYPUkr1rE7Tt2l6-il0v9XFcdpKQGGmXBJnDJXW-b5aEGhbhJlw8RTvw-CX7GlehZkCu7-q-191N_V-mtaKaxVmevzy-Pzkvg_t668f7b9cmjJCfqcYiftBWDnflC6kpamfKGof9Z8AAAD__yooo50)

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** You probably know that C.S. Lewis also wrote the children's series, _The Chronicles of Narnia_. My wife and I read those books to our children so many times! I can't tell you how many dog-eared copies we have of these.

One of the best parts of this course is learning how the Christian faith is woven into these captivating stories. **I hope you 'll take advantage of this great FREE DVD offer today:** [https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-cs-lewis-christianity-dvd](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U1r3DAQBuBfI99s9LX27sGHBGehkLT0A3IUimbWOyBbQiM7zb8vW7bQc64zwzzwvq8v7sVTpHX-6hccidlBAleQsez4kbYCO7yl34zVaan7Vg6tUc6HSjs66xsYD1odL8cGRzUcD_Z0OljbXMdgEHuDKHulpNeo3nrwWtleyxAQQ0Pj7Z8cjFJaHqzuLKIc1AAnsArNEYWVWwZfsaOVCZBDSjmnSJUCd6nMTRyvtWYW5kHos9BnWi-pu1KMDD5ih7AJfb4UxDZwG_GduA3XQlzJr1Q_WthBmDMHYSYptTYPUkr1rE7Tt2l6-il0v9XFcdpKQGGmXBJnDJXW-b5aEGhbhJlw8RTvw-CX7GlehZkCu7-q-191N_V-mtaKaxVmevzy-Pzkvg_t668f7b9cmjJCfqcYiftBWDnflC6kpamfKGof9Z8AAAD__yooo50)

**Connecting with Conroy – July 31st, 2026**
Summer is in full swing, and so is my campaign to retake Ohio-01 for Republicans and defeat liberal Greg Landsman. All summer, our team has been connecting with voters: attending events, hosting meet-and-greets, knocking on doors, and building the infrastructure needed to win in November. It has been a busy few months, but I am energized and excited to continue this fight for the people of this district. We will continue to work each and every day to show why I am the best candidate in this race, with common sense policies that will make Southwest Ohio safer, stronger, and more prosperous. - Eric Conroy

body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2599%2E5691347%2EhC_15w)

Peter,
You know why I’m reaching out — it’s to humbly ask for your support in my reelection campaign here in Georgia.
But before I ask for your contribution, I think you deserve an explanation for why this race is so important, and why I’m asking for your support, particularly right now.
**I am MAGA’s #1 target in the midterms.**
Don’t forget, we’re talking about _Georgia_. The most competitive battleground state _in the country._
And something that folks aren’t paying enough attention to is that National Republicans have vastly more resources than National Democrats right now.
I expect the GOP and their Super PACs will spend _hundreds of millions of dollars_ against me.
So I’m asking you to take nothing for granted. This is something you can do _right now_ that will have a BIG impact: [**Make a donation to my reelection campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260731-1-f&utm_campaign=em260731-1-f&t=2&akid=2599%2E5691347%2EhC_15w)
Peter, my campaign won't accept contributions from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. That means the vast majority of the donations that fuel this campaign come from emails just like this one. People chipping in $10, $25, or $50 at a time.
And the money we raise _right now_ means we mobilize more voters in every corner of the state, place more ads to spread my message across Georgia, and hire more staff to sustain and even expand our efforts.
And while I certainly don't expect you or anyone else to donate to every email my team and I send, I hope you'll consider donating to this one today.
[**Can you please make a $5 contribution to my reelection campaign today? name: Chris Pappas
subject: I'm still sorry about Karoline Leavitt.
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=8040%2E582294%2E4n5dv6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=8040%2E582294%2E4n5dv6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate

Karoline
Leavitt is lying to you.

I recently turned on the TV to see Karoline Leavitt at the White House
podium claiming, “Gas prices decreased over the past year,” – which we
both know couldn’t be further from the truth.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260731_1.2x5JAh&refcode=em20260731-1&t=1003&akid=8040%2E582294%2E4n5dv6 ]Karoline Leavitt is lying

Look, Granite Staters got the first taste of Karoline Leavitt’s MAGA spin
when she ran against me for Congress a few years ago. Voters saw right
through it and rejected her agenda — by nearly 10 points.

Now Karoline Leavitt is bringing those same talking points New Hampshire
voters dismissed to the national stage.

If you’re wondering how the rest of the country ended up having to listen
to Karoline Leavitt’s “spin,” it’s because New Hampshire proved something
important first: MAGA’s lies don’t hold up when you stay focused on real,
kitchen-table issues.

None of this has stopped the MAGA machine from trying again in NH.
National Republicans are planning to invest tens of millions of dollars
into our state, because they think they can notch a win here to cling to
their Senate majority.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260731_1.2x5JAh&refcode=em20260731-1&t=1004&akid=8040%2E582294%2E4n5dv6 ]But I’ve beaten their playbook before, and now I need your help to do
it again. Will you chip in $5 to help us keep this Senate
seat blue?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260731_1.2x5JAh&amount=5&refcode=em20260731-1&t=1023&akid=8040%2E582294%2E4n5dv6 ]Donate $5 »

If you believe New Hampshire should keep leading the way and showing the
rest of the country that MAGA politics don’t work here, I’m asking you to
be a part of our campaign.

Thanks for being in this with me.

Chris

|
Peter,
Weeks ago, in his national address on election, Trump made a dubious claim that he had discovered more than 250,000 noncitizens registered to vote in just four states. But nobody from the Trump administration can explain where that number came from.
The Department of Homeland Security ran the analysis, but has refused to reveal its methodology. Officials in the affected states are asking basic questions and getting silence. Was AI used? What lists did they even look at? No answers.
Now, NPR is reporting that multiple state officials fear these numbers will be used by the Trump administration as pretext for federal law enforcement interference in counting votes this November.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001elr3j9A1Xb95btyMmlsQaIRdFPTQfu1WB9EamxTWE_Y-WJLCZ6vBUkVxlGzLo5d9g8mzFpfyJ1LSW5HI9SUf7jkDdx5c5xY40HwmVJb-9Is-JfSVEN7w_iIdJZmcgPrW3y6Mpn_B1w0sn0T_bczDcgQg3vedvymUiJack_mqzjg0JJMzgjCw5xkSWcjuwyvmemYiVs-7Ly5q-4vvr9-cmxJ87CMmKcsdhTpeb7eYPkk=&c=UtFGsBMYKWnVt_tASGhEuVTCM0x4vNQFHbQxLEIKaOzSjZBM_R3lxQ==&ch=lDhPn58Se9Nyw-2ebIwBdH5XG6CvaEYv_dwzN2UVW5hj6IqNeB2mBg==)

| Trump is manufacturing chaos to strong-arm states and rig the election. Study after study shows noncitizen voting is vanishingly rare. But Trump is betting on finding the right court that will let him steal this election.
One official laid out the nightmare scenario: a friendly judge issues subpoenas the day after Election Day, agents show up at a county office in a close race, and walk out with the ballots "so we can count them." It's not just hypothetical either, it has already been done--the FBI already seized 2020 ballots in Fulton County, Georgia, on an affidavit built on misinformation.
This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. We're building a firewall of state Supreme Courts, the courts with ultimate say over election law in their states, and the last line of defense when Trump tries to steal an election in broad daylight.
Tonight at midnight is our end-of-month deadline. Tomorrow, we'll be exactly three months from Election Day. To fight at the scale this moment demands, we have to dramatically build our war chest, right now. And that means we need the help of Democrats everywhere today.

body:
Peter,

Tonight at midnight, we reach our final end-of-month fundraising deadline before the August 4 Primary Election.

When the clock strikes midnight, we'll be just _four days_ away from polls opening, and I'll be honest with you (as I always am): **We're still falling short of our $25,000 Primary Fund goal.**

I'm asking for your help because these last few days matter. I got into this race because I believe St. Louisans deserve a representative who shows up, listens, and delivers results for the people who call this community home.

body:
| Peter,

Most folks assume that if you run for public office, you have at least a basic respect for the Constitution. You don't have to agree on every policy, but surely _everyone agrees that the Constitution sets the rules for how we govern. Right?_

Wrong. When I served in the Iowa Legislature, there were several times when I'd read a bill and immediately realized it was _plainly unconstitutional._ I thought, _What in the world are we doing?_ I would explain that the bill couldn't legally be enforced as written because it violated the Constitution. One time, after I made that point, a committee chair shrugged and said, "We're going to do it anyway."

Too many politicians are so focused on scoring political points or pleasing party leaders that they stop asking the questions they're supposed to ask. Is this constitutional? Will it have unintended consequences? Will it actually help the people we represent? **Instead, they throw ideas at the wall and hope something sticks, leaving taxpayers to deal with the consequences.**

Unfortunately, we've seen that same mindset in Congress over the past several years. Politicians like Mariannette Miller-Meeks have repeatedly chosen party loyalty over Congress’s constitutional responsibilities to represent the people.

I'm running because I believe our Constitution is the framework that allows us to serve the American people honestly and responsibly. I genuinely look forward to digging into policy, asking difficult questions, and using every responsibility of a sitting representative to make life better for Iowa families.

If you believe that's the kind of representation Iowa deserves, will you make a donation before midnight tonight? **We're working toward our $15,000 fundraising goal, and every contribution helps us build the campaign we'll need to defeat Mariannette Miller-Meeks in November >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cb-q3-2026?refcode2=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136335974/637132728/-2016015222?refcode=em26_260731_EOM5_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260731_EOM5_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=e1afecb9-df8c-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMWFmZWNiOS1kZjhjLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J2N_e3kZezh0hrudaP7SzOJWSxQEdaSqgiUA9FDwJV0=)**

| Friday, July 31, 2026| Iran War Widens As Hamas Deal Announced
---|---
5-minute read · 4 stories
Lead Story · Foreign PolicyIRAN WAR REIGNITES AS TRUMP ANNOUNCES HAMAS DISARMAMENT DEALWhat's Happening
* The U.S. and Iran are again trading strikes after a fragile ceasefire collapsed on July 8, with the conflict widening across the region.
* President Trump announced what he called a **"historic agreement"** for the complete disarmament of Hamas, while Saudi Arabia readied a military campaign against the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen.
* Saudi Arabia announced a 14-nation naval coalition aimed at keeping the Bab el-Mandeb Strait open to shipping.

The Situation
* Four U.S. service members have died from Iran-launched strikes since the ceasefire fell apart; Trump attended a dignified transfer for the fallen last week.
* The war began Feb. 28 with joint U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iranian military, government and infrastructure sites.
* Details of the Hamas disarmament agreement, including enforcement and timing, had not been independently confirmed as of publication.

The PerspectiveThe loss of four Americans is a sober reminder that this is a real war with real costs, and those families deserve the nation's gratitude and prayers. If the Hamas disarmament deal holds and Gulf partners are willing to shoulder the burden of policing their own waters, that is a meaningful step toward a more stable region and less reliance on U.S. boots. But announcements are not outcomes, and the administration owes the country a clear strategy and an honest accounting as the fighting drags on.[Read the full story at Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_N8M2yF9-VjcaxkG0L0zQSVmTJIXpgNSt33r0m9zLoxbFSvEm10vMX0nbxKLI1EfvjvwknaHZzCuXXxvcsqWKgUvLdHAfw9zHKGtANxe-ZrdgZFtiIzSG7B5cCgPHtuTGA9I2p680CRGXCqYRmvpZKfSw6FNRM5So3iItWnjOXSMPLnJEcqZphPodOYEwpjMvgz88hCnQ-0BAOrQWeJyJsx8Mi5iIqwO-lDfVCRZSC454_9hdaVlmmyAFBZhgV8QTTL-DNuXbJkB_lRqPKTM54MMfxo8qLwr2y3kAnz1JNmPtYCHHEwlGdlMr1Fy7HaQig/4ss/U05byLD2QOChbmZx5JGHXA/h1/h001.zU2BdvCrXEw3UnUs4F_gMzSAOK1q4sErRJ6qMEzKqfU)

War PowersSENATE BLOCKS BID TO CURB TRUMP'S IRAN WAR POWERSWhat's Happening
* The Senate narrowly voted down a war powers resolution Thursday, **50-49** , on a procedural vote that would have forced Trump to pull U.S. forces from "hostilities" with Iran.
* Three Republicans — Susan Collins, Rand Paul and Lisa Murkowski — backed the measure; Sen. John Fetterman was the only Democrat to oppose it.
* The resolution, introduced by Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand, was the latest in a string of failed Democratic attempts to constrain the president.

The Situation
* Sen. Mitch McConnell missed the vote due to ongoing health issues; the measure would have required another vote before final passage.
* Sen. Thom Tillis said he would reconsider his position by early September if the administration had not sought congressional approval by then.
* GOP support for the administration's Iran policy has held steady despite the mounting U.S. casualties.

The PerspectiveA commander in chief needs the flexibility to respond when American troops are under fire, and the Senate was right not to tie his hands in the middle of an active fight. That said, the Constitution gives Congress the war power for a reason, and the honest conservative position is that if this conflict stretches into the fall, the administration should come to Capitol Hill and make its case rather than lean indefinitely on executive authority.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyWFa1tWox1t_YE5rpY7L5b5x8lVvQuZBVbKQGo5O6UJSEM95p8t93Ju9w3-wpC4mBH801KqFA7KSb3KYq2nhx31B2E-QVmcSsoANw3zWkfm_Oxe70i4dQ_QwUMBQp9jeTKhVsBuQ3gGAN7297O4fkNxIRRc243EXwApMd10n9BV7Fwr1GQlctxV2ybldRsRpHXTS-iQL6jJGJtQ6iREUmg0L19qqZZNlTtu27T2dhUcE1dnr85I8SVkF4aiOKOMrdCS3juRHKttRMYJ2-6MInnCfKqn3ulgcVaYxbSQ2VQpBMOTlkrR4Alng0zCUlZU8ZI/4ss/U05byLD2QOChbmZx5JGHXA/h2/h001.TzahqJYkqSoTnIeLYT7TzN8ZU181B6De3GZE8SyBJQE)

The Justice DepartmentBLANCHE AG NOMINATION STALLS AS TRUMP THREATENS TO PULL ITWhat's Happening
* The Senate Judiciary Committee postponed its vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general after two Republicans withheld support.
* Trump threatened on Truth Social to **temporarily withdraw** the nomination until Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis leave office in January.
* Neither Cornyn nor Tillis faces reelection in November, limiting Trump's political leverage over them.

The Situation
* The holdouts want the Justice Department to confirm in writing that a roughly $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization" fund, created in an IRS lawsuit settlement, is permanently dead.
* They are also pressing to narrow settlement provisions that shielded Trump, his family and companies from IRS audits.
* The DOJ had verbally backtracked on the fund after bipartisan criticism but has not formalized that commitment.

The PerspectiveThe president is entitled to his own attorney general, and the delay is a headache the administration would rather avoid with a war on. But the senators asking for a written guarantee that a $1.8 billion fund won't be weaponized, and for the removal of special audit protections for the president's own family, are asking for something reasonable. Putting that commitment in writing costs the administration nothing if it was sincere — and it would settle the matter quickly.[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_Hww93iPI4LJrShhMJMeWsBt-c-BHFUXz-GNp26MpR5k0Q24OyXxX6VgoXq_zGU1HtXrWXKXjqvA4k3wgcA7FMM4xhwXFlVlphGlFhpQiOM237yEYIFIjhklT9TN828ENxF49EY18J32KbHJG_GZ5vXvVO9UB3Ry-I_XLLYv6fzBVLjIXXMXKauMG3VT7jSbmoFpI-r_6K9EDczT7BvwasJosOOBFQgXqgWLoSjTFfHFrhSMqpZ04dtKHbkamJuaP1Kp71Dr3Ac_TONNr8vj2XsEJn9NyA9_p1Q9E9Id2pT52AT6ObVdfe8Aix-VmfTayz5qNC3NqHCh0YS2b2tr95Be0uZiZr2wVpWa6d4bCXoNRY5wsJEpZYuqJ5hiLl33ag/4ss/U05byLD2QOChbmZx5JGHXA/h3/h001.PpyfBxz0gei9WQZ-oad5zZPuH22KO3jHFKtPSljUm8A)

The EconomyGDP GROWTH SLOWS TO 1.5% AS CONSUMERS PROP UP THE ECONOMYWhat's Happening
* The economy grew at an inflation-adjusted **1.5% annual rate** in the second quarter, down from 2.1% in the first, according to a preliminary estimate.
* Consumer spending accelerated to a robust 3.2% pace, and AI-driven investment in data centers and equipment continued to power growth.
* Final sales to private domestic purchasers, a cleaner gauge of underlying demand, rose at a strong 3.9% rate.

The Situation
* Inventories, imports and government spending dragged on the headline number, factors that typically don't signal future weakness.
* Inflation ran at 3.5% in the year through June, down from a 4.2% high in May but still well above the Fed's 2% target.
* The Fed held interest rates steady this week, with three board members dissenting in favor of a hike.

The PerspectiveA 1.5% headline looks soft, but the details tell a more encouraging story: private demand is healthy, the consumer is holding up, and the AI buildout is real investment in America's productive capacity. The honest caveat is that inflation at 3.5% is still eating into paychecks, and no amount of strong GDP prints will feel like a win at the grocery store until prices actually settle down.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyWslDrlWqxLOtIy7S3gUPIAt01wEj71HjGYL6JM9b3XwG4G6YY_UxBtMsKLSHIULJEJF-rErBHKtPonDkfIoAAavS8jsf0SJDW-LtKvqbZzZzifplgtsugUCgSICnzCyk1WJ0PqI238s8BWOKkdwI6EgRjH1XjnfGtGbfvFNP15NlEw-pTuAlsG-Jom7d1mh1rjTbUnavg1MbA3muDTaj9D2Hi4CeIuY0k4v9gQ0oWYS5gIChli8YlMldADNuTdJPeJ0RLCNLXWxcyL0JSq6StT0IKQAuLyxKPvSSxAfhxaVZ_b4ukkg8DC3pMd6WyWy3k/4ss/U05byLD2QOChbmZx5JGHXA/h4/h001.xSIDtF3UU-mvG7bCm0l64sq76aobLQWGdmFVZZ5FIG8)
| ⚡ The Bottom LineA widening war with four Americans lost, a Senate that won't tie the president's hands but may not stay quiet forever, a stalled nominee, and an economy that's slowing but not stalling — today is about the weight of the moment and the limits of any one leader's control. **\-----------Forwarded Message-----------**
**From:** Stacey Abrams
**Subject** : His election lies were never about fraud
Apparently, Donald Trump needs more reminders of a simple fact: he lost the 2020 election.
He recently relitigated his defeat in a primetime presidential address, which was a rerun of previously debunked claims, undercut by the very same documents he released as “proof.”
Americans see through the lies. **Here in Georgia, we certainly know this playbook, because Trump and his allies ran it here first.** And we know that his false claims of fraud are really about power — trying to control whose voices get heard, and whose get silenced:
1. Trump may have demanded that Georgia leaders “find 11,780 votes.” While they refused to commit treason, the next year they delivered laws to make it harder to vote by mail, register to vote and stay on the rolls, and have that vote counted.
2. Trump’s Department of Justice sent federal agents into the elections office in Fulton County, Georgia, and also went after election offices in Arizona and Michigan.
3. Now, Trump and his allies want to make their lies into federal law: new barriers between citizens and the ballot, aimed at the same voters who have always had to fight hardest to be heard.

Rep. Torrey C. Harris

name: LeftAction
subject: Don't Let These Morons Attack an American Hero
body:
Science, not BS
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Don't Let These GOP Morons Attack an American Hero](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc290a270-35a0-47af-bbe2-2dd72cd134b8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Dr. Anthony Fauci spent more than half a century using science to protect Americans from infectious diseases. The nation could have learned a lot from a hearing on COVID, and maybe figured out how to be better prepared for the next pandemic. **[But Republican senators instead used it to attack Dr. Anthony Fauci—a man who spent more than 50 years fighting infectious diseases.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T26d5cf97-584c-45e1-ba99-b15a381df382/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** [****](https://default.salsalabs.org/T57460988-a040-4144-bdbd-ba73df5bc9ec/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Why? Because they're too spineless to point the finger at Donald Trump, the village idiot who was president when COVID exploded onto the scene and who used his remarkable powers of jackassery to f*** things up as much as possible. So instead of taking responsibility, Republicans invent ridiculous conspiracy theories woven together from strands of pure bullshit to distract Americans from Trump's failures. While Fauci urged Americans to follow the best available scientific evidence, Trump promoted hydroxychloroquine, mused about injecting disinfectant, and helped create an environment in which misinformation spread faster than the virus itself. Now Republicans are still trying to make Fauci the villain. **Add your name, and demand they BACK OFF.** This latest hearing was especially disgraceful. Republican senators screamed at the 85-year-old scientist, threatened him with prison, and generally behaved like internet trolls who somehow wandered into the United States Senate. Ohio Senator Bernie Moreno even dropped the F-bomb in a pathetic attempt to look tough. Enough of this crap. It's time to stand up, and stop letting these morons attack those working incredibly hard, using science and reality to help keep us safe. Republicans are persecuting scientists while empowering conspiracy theorists. **[Add your name, and tell these Republican senators to back off](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5152bdbb-2a9a-472a-9756-1ae060012d22/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).**

body:
California Democrats are fast-tracking a bill called the “Stop Nick Shirley Act” that threatens everything Nick and LMF are doing.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e772802/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvNXZBdUNkcFljcA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MzE/LbmNsbDRHRjluOA/qP2hpZHM9bmN2UjRTWjdiRkJRejBscw/gamyhyQ/sbi98e8eb00)

# Friend,
---
Just days ago, independent journalist **Nick Shirley** walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. _Why the panic?_ Because California Democrats are fast-tracking **AB 2624** — already being called the **“Stop Nick Shirley Act.”** This bill would make it a **crime** for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities — exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick’s ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled — or even criminalized — with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means:
---
* Nick’s explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice?
* His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs?
* Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility?

---
**All of it could be criminalized under this new law.** The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: **“Stop exposing the fraud...**** _or we’ll make sure you can’t.”_** And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they’re trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. **That’s why Lincoln Media Foundation exists — and why we’re asking for your help again today.** LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that **directly funds** independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work — travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security — so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. Right now, your tax-deductible donation to LMF will go **toward supporting Nick Shirley** and protecting his ability to continue this critical work in the face of this new threat.

---
* Keep Nick in the field investigating government waste and fraud
* Amplify videos so millions more Americans see the truth
* Fight back against attempts to criminalize independent journalism

---
Nick doesn’t have corporate backing or political protection. He has the truth — and the support of people like you through Lincoln Media Foundation. If you believe taxpayers deserve to know where their money is really going... If you believe citizen journalists should not be threatened with jail time for asking tough questions... body:

Peter,
We’re closing in on the July deadline tonight at midnight — and my team tells me that we’re so close to meeting our **$100,000** end-of-month fundraising goal.
These fundraising goals are vital for our campaign. **We may not have Greg Abbott’s mega-millions at our disposal, but we don’t need them.** We just need to keep raising what we need to run an efficient and effective statewide campaign.
Fresh off the heels of another poll showing us within a single digit of Greg Abbott, this campaign is building some serious momentum — and _that’s all thanks to you._
**[Peter, our campaign is in a position to defeat Greg Abbott. But we have to meet our July fundraising goal to keep this movement on track. While families worry about the cost of groceries, gas, housing, and health care, Trump and Republicans in Congress spent their time working on literally anything else besides issue number one.| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136345551/637161919/-1283252511?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU0NTUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYThmMzA3NmYtZTU4Yy1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i2b-b2LNoqGKtTJMnWsErhHenmYqXOjQHDYNQokxb-E=&emci=7c7a5cf6-e08c-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=a8f3076f-e58c-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=12466492)

| | | Friend —
---
As we say bye to July, I’m reflecting on this past month’s reminders of what's wrong with Washington.
---
While families worry about the cost of groceries, gas, housing, and health care, Trump and Republicans in Congress spent their time working on literally _anything else_ besides issue number one.
---
And as their corruption and abuses of power continue to pile up, too many in Congress have chosen silence over accountability.
---
But that's not the whole story. **I've seen something else this month.**
---
From celebrations of our nation’s 250th birthday to summer sporting events and concerts, I’ve spoken with countless Rhode Islanders who are stepping up for our community. Small business owners creating jobs. **Families fighting for a better future for their kids.**
---
We deserve a government that works just as hard.
---
I’m fighting to lower costs rather than raising them with war and tariffs. **An opportunity economy that rewards hard work** , not just wealth. And a democracy that allows all of our voices to be heard.
---

Folks,
I might be a little biased, but Northern Minnesota is the best place in the world to grow up. From long summer nights out at the lake to learning how to ice fish in the winter, I learned to cherish everything that makes our corner of this country so special.
Beyond all the outdoor fun, growing up in Hermantown taught me the value of strong community and finding dignity in work. My mom worked as a nurse and my dad worked in construction and then at the paper mill. We weren’t rich, but we never wanted for much.
Since then, it has become much harder for Greater Minnesota families to achieve a middle-class standard of living. Too many people in our district are struggling to afford basic necessities like rent, child care, and groceries. I’m running for Congress to tackle the cost-of-living crisis with bold leadership. Ahead of our end-of-month deadline, I need your help to bridge our $2,840 fundraising gap — can you please donate $50 today? I learned from an early age that unions built our middle class and allowed people like my parents to build a good life for their families. But over the past few decades, anti-worker politicians like Pete Stauber have done everything they can to crush the working class, while rich Republican donors become wealthier than ever before.
The workers who built our northern and central Minnesota communities—the nurses, the carpenters, the millworkers, the miners, the teachers—deserve a representative who puts this district first, not special interests.

I never thought I would run for Congress, but when I stepped away from a career in the federal government, I knew that I wanted to continue to serve. I’m running to give a voice to those who feel left behind by self-serving politicians like Pete Stauber. Together, we can work to ensure our communities remain affordable for the folks who live here, so the next generation can live, work, and thrive right here at home. Please donate any amount today to support our movement for change.
Thank you,
Trina

name: Doug Ollivant for Congress
subject: Don’t let Vindman win by default
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY OLLIVANT FOR CONGRESS
body:
Make your plan today. This is our chance to stop the Spanberger-Vindman path.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/7MChE1vCScv?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Dear Friends & Neighbors,
Early voting is underway across Virginia’s 7th District. _**You have today and tomorrow (Saturday, August 1) to vote early. Then it’s Election Day on Tuesday, August 4.**_
This primary isn’t just about who gets the Republican nomination. It’s about who can actually beat Yevgeny Vindman in November.
Vindman is counting on us to nominate someone weak. Someone who won’t make him defend the record he’s inheriting. That record is Abigail Spanberger’s failing affordability policies: higher costs, squeezed families, and no real solutions. On top of that, he aligns with the progressive wing and its socialist ideals that only make the problem worse.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/AJSPZV1MBwZ?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)Let’s also be clear about what else is at stake. The last thing this country needs is Yevgeny in Congress managing the next impeachment of President Trump and trying to stretch out another 15 minutes of fame with his brother. We can end that story right here in Virginia’s 7th District.
I’ve spent my career in combat zones and putting **America** ’s values of **First** to support and defend The Constitution. An oath I continue to live by.
From day one, my campaign has been built on integrity, transparency, and results over empty talk. [**This is a race backed by Virginians, not dominated by out of state money or controlled by special interests and we are not walking the same old tired walk that gets us nowhere.**](https://us.list-manage.com/zCLWWuO0y3y?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
If you haven’t voted yet, make a plan and go. [**Early voting ends Saturday.**](https://us.list-manage.com/_z7U_vCccB4?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0) Don’t wait.
If you already voted, thank you. Now pull three more people with you. Text them. Call them. Make sure they show up.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/19YDZBb6BmO?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)This is our chance to put forward a candidate who can win the general election and reject the Spanberger-Vindman path. Let’s seize the opportunity.
Vote early while you still can. Vote on August 4 if you must. Just vote and vote like November depends on it.
Because it does.

Thank you in advance for standing with me.

**Your Candidate for U.S. Congress****Virginia’s 7th Congressional District**

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _
