name: Adam Dunigan
subject: Concerning the Recent Controversy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Adam for Congress[Vote](https://us
body:
There's no controversy, but nobody opens these things unless I say something weird in the subject line. I'm sorry. ☹️

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | |
Hey all!
Adam here. There’s no controversy, but nobody seems to open these unless I put something weird in the subject line. So, you know.
Anyway, here we are! It’s Friday afternoon, July 31st, and we are closing out the last full week of the 2026 Virginia Democratic primary race. Voting day is Tuesday, August 4th. So go vote if you haven’t already.
We’ve got roughly 5 days left until we find out whether we made it or not. I’m not nervous at all. Nope. Not nervous. Why are you asking? Do I seem nervous? I don’t like the insinuation. Or your tone. I’M NOT NERVOUS. YOU’RE NERVOUS.
Ah jeez. Now I’m yelling. I apologize. I may be 5% nervous. But only because things are going so well! Lots of big updates below. We _just might_ pull off the biggest upset in Virginia politics. And some important people are certainly paying attention now. In this week’s edition:
* A mostly impartial [voter guide](https://us.list-manage.com/16Nrb2xqO_4?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) for undecided voters. Give it a watch and send to friends.
* [Adam Kinzinger gave us his endorsement](https://us.list-manage.com/140RgbY8Uza?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Had a great chat.
* James Talarico and Kamala Harris also started following us? Pretty cool. (I hope they see this. Hi guys! You can endorse me too if you want. 👁️ 👄 👁️ )
* [Recent media appearances](https://us.list-manage.com/V_6Hq1L3FMe?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Check them out!
* Election watch party on August 4th. Everyone in the area should attend.
* We’re providing some resources on how and where to vote on August 4th.

As always, if you can spare a few bucks right now, [please donate](https://us.list-manage.com/v7hp1XTllLr?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). It’ll go directly to our digital advertising campaign. As much as I hate begging for money, then putting that money in the pockets of social media giants, it’s a necessary evil if we want to win this. And, it turns out, we just might win this.
We have a real shot at pulling off the upset here in Northern Virginia, y’all. Tell everyone you know: Where once we were the dark horse...
Behold, a pale horse, And the name it said on us was “Adam for Congress.”
And hell follows with us.
_-_ Adam
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/XPEL7ciR_CB?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | **Voter Guide Is Here!** We made a (mostly impartial) voter guide. I did my best to keep it factual, saved my personal thoughts and opinions toward the end. So, if you know anyone still making their mind up about August 4th, forward liberally. I was also slightly silly in this video. Lightly humorous. Modestly tomfoolish. So maybe that’ll make this boring political stuff a little more fun. Let me know what you think.
We also made a [fun video specifically for Republicans!](https://us.list-manage.com/yUprxBq9uf_?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) So, send this around to your conservative friends who need to hear it. Especially if they live in Virginia’s 8th.
---
| | **Things to Know About August 4th** Voting on August 4th may be daunting if you’ve never voted in a primary, but we’re here to make it simple. Watch [the video above](https://us.list-manage.com/fHrsuHrN5it?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) for the long version, or if you just want the links and info, here they are:
**Where and When to Vote** If you’re already registered, [click here to find your polling place and hours](https://us.list-manage.com/j5MJi8xMNlI?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Go vote, don’t procrastinate. On election day, remember: If you’re in line to vote, even after closing hours, they have to let you vote. So go participate in your democracy, and don’t take “no” for an answer.
**Not Registered to Vote? No Problem!**[Click here to make sure you’re registered](https://us.list-manage.com/fZvjALia0Ml?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0), and if you’re not, [click here to find out how to register to vote.](https://us.list-manage.com/17xRoMAJJSm?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) Virginia lets you register and vote same-day in person at the polls, so there’s no excuse to sit this election out. Show up on August 4th, bring the required documents, and register/vote. DO THIS. GO VOTE. EVERYONE VOTE. Doesn’t have to be for me, just show up for your democracy right now, it’s important.
**Notice Any Tomfoolery on August 4th?** So, this is kind of important: Trump and the DOJ are sending “election observers” to locations across Virginia on August 4th. This may be nothing, but it’s possible that some of those observers may try to intimidate or interfere with polling operations on election day. If you see anything that feels off, make a report to the [Election Protection hotline](https://us.list-manage.com/ollY7Rp7tbz?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). No need to freak out, but vigilance is the price of democracy. So be vigilant.
---
| | **Media Appearances** Here’s our list of recent media appearances. My favorite was the Adam Kinzinger interview, but we did pretty well on WUSA9 too. At any rate, watch all of them. Comment, like, do all the social media things so the algorithm takes notice.
[Adam and Adam: Let’s get at ‘em (Kinzinger interview)](https://us.list-manage.com/_7LSkI_M26W?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)[WUSA9 and ABC7 Candidate Profiles](https://us.list-manage.com/1BWIC0MPkoP?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)[Appearance on the Destiny Livestream](https://us.list-manage.com/Ec7dTEcIB8F?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)[Appearance on the David Clayton Stream](https://us.list-manage.com/3EGf6RK3ZQw?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)[Educational Piece: How to Spot a CIA Plant](https://us.list-manage.com/heWBctRdRYZ?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) (VERY important, must watch)
---
| | **Election Night Party**[7pm, Tuesday, August 4th; Courthaus Social](https://us.list-manage.com/1tqo7M74wL7?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)[Arlington, Virginia](https://us.list-manage.com/12nLYMrZdeP?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
Come one, come all. Whatever may happen August 4th, we’ll all be together. Open bar, as long as it takes, we link arms and walk across this finish line as one. Come through and meet the rest of the campaign family. And my actual family! My Uncle Joe and Aunt Sue are coming and they’re pretty cool, I like them. I’m pretty sure they read our newsletters too. Hi, Uncle Joe and Aunt Sue!
---
| | **News from the Front**
Finally, to end this newsletter, a dispatch from the field. This is a firsthand account written by one of our volunteers from his experience out canvassing recently.
_“The other day I met a lady on the street while canvassing. I went up to her to spread the message about Adam Dunigan per usual. After a long conversation with her about Adam, I learned that she actually worked with Don Beyer, the candidate Adam is running against, back when he was US Ambassador to Switzerland._
_However, regardless of her previous connection to Beyer, she stated she also believed Beyer had been in office for too long and really liked Adam’s platform; she also said she thinks he’s a very strong candidate and after doing some more research, would definitely look into voting for Adam._
_Then, when we were finishing up our conversation, another lady on the street came up to us. She saw I was wearing an Adam Dunigan shirt and came to show her support. She then proceeded to help me persuade the other lady to vote for Adam Dunigan. This experience just showed me how much support Adam is really getting as a first time runner and how even long time Beyer supporters are starting to change sides.”_

This kid is 15 years old. I was a little idiot when I was 15. I definitely wasn’t chatting up strangers about congressional politics. And yet, he and all of his fellow youths on the A4C campaign are out doing the work to save this country. Fire of democracy in their heart, clarity of purpose in their eyes. I’m honored by everyone helping this campaign, but especially by our A4C Youth Corps.
You’re the best of us, kids. Here’s to you.
---
| | | | | |
Indefatigably yours,**Adam Dunigan**
Congressional CandidateVirginia's 8th District

I did my best to keep it factual, saved my personal thoughts and opinions toward the end. So, if you know anyone still making their mind up about August 4th, forward liberally. I was also slightly silly in this video. Lightly humorous. Modestly tomfoolish. So maybe that’ll make this boring political stuff a little more fun. Let me know what you think. We also made a So, send this around to your conservative friends who need to hear it. Especially if they live in Virginia’s 8th. | | Things to Know About August 4th Voting on August 4th may be daunting if you’ve never voted in a primary, but we’re here to make it simple. Watch for the long version, or if you just want the links and info, here they are: Where and When to Vote If you’re already registered, . Go vote, don’t procrastinate. On election day, remember: If you’re in line to vote, even after closing hours, they have to let you vote. So go participate in your democracy, and don’t take “no” for an answer. Not Registered to Vote? No Problem!, and if you’re not, Virginia lets you register and vote same-day in person at the polls, so there’s no excuse to sit this election out. Show up on August 4th, bring the required documents, and register/vote. DO THIS. GO VOTE. EVERYONE VOTE. Doesn’t have to be for me, just show up for your democracy right now, it’s important. Notice Any Tomfoolery on August 4th? So, this is kind of important: Trump and the DOJ are sending “election observers” to locations across Virginia on August 4th. This may be nothing, but it’s possible that some of those observers may try to intimidate or interfere with polling operations on election day. If you see anything that feels off, make a report to the . No need to freak out, but vigilance is the price of democracy. So be vigilant. | | Media Appearances Here’s our list of recent media appearances. My favorite was the Adam Kinzinger interview, but we did pretty well on WUSA9 too. At any rate, watch all of them. Comment, like, do all the social media things so the algorithm takes notice. (VERY important, must watch) | | Election Night Party Come one, come all. Whatever may happen August 4th, we’ll all be together. Open bar, as long as it takes, we link arms and walk across this finish line as one. Come through and meet the rest of the campaign family. And my actual family! My Uncle Joe and Aunt Sue are coming and they’re pretty cool, I like them. I’m pretty sure they read our newsletters too. Hi, Uncle Joe and Aunt Sue! | | News from the Front Finally, to end this newsletter, a dispatch from the field. This is a firsthand account written by one of our volunteers from his experience out canvassing recently. “The other day I met a lady on the street while canvassing. I went up to her to spread the message about Adam Dunigan per usual. After a long conversation with her about Adam, I learned that she actually worked with Don Beyer, the candidate Adam is running against, back when he was US Ambassador to Switzerland. However, regardless of her previous connection to Beyer, she stated she also believed Beyer had been in office for too long and really liked Adam’s platform; she also said she thinks he’s a very strong candidate and after doing some more research, would definitely look into voting for Adam. Then, when we were finishing up our conversation, another lady on the street came up to us. She saw I was wearing an Adam Dunigan shirt and came to show her support. She then proceeded to help me persuade the other lady to vote for Adam Dunigan. This experience just showed me how much support Adam is really getting as a first time runner and how even long time Beyer supporters are starting to change sides.” This kid is 15 years old. I was a little idiot when I was 15. I definitely wasn’t chatting up strangers about congressional politics. And yet, he and all of his fellow youths on the A4C campaign are out doing the work to save this country. Fire of democracy in their heart, clarity of purpose in their eyes. I’m honored by everyone helping this campaign, but especially by our A4C Youth Corps. You’re the best of us, kids. Here’s to you. | | | | | | Indefatigably yours,Adam Dunigan Congressional CandidateVirginia's 8th District | | Paid for by Adam for Congress | | | | | | | or |

* * *
**By Wendy Yurgo**
For years, Anthony Fauci asked the American people to trust him. Trust his judgment. Trust his expertise. Trust that unprecedented restrictions on American life were necessary because the science demanded them. Businesses closed. Schools emptied. Churches locked their doors. Families were separated from dying loved ones. Millions of Americans accepted sacrifices they never imagined because they believed the people directing the response were telling them the truth about what they knew, what they did not know, and why those extraordinary decisions were being made.
On July 29, 2026, that trust was finally put to its own test.
Anthony Fauci appeared before the United States Senate under subpoena. For years, America had listened while he spoke. Now Congress was asking the questions. After years of explaining and defending the government's pandemic response from podiums, television studios, and congressional hearing rooms, Fauci was asked to explain those same decisions under oath.
He repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment.
Every American possesses that constitutional right. The question is not whether Dr. Fauci could remain silent. The question is whether the nation's most influential public health official, after asking the American people to place extraordinary trust in his judgment, had a corresponding obligation to explain that judgment when Congress finally demanded answers.
That obligation did not arise because he was a private citizen.
It arose because of the authority he exercised.
It arose because of the confidence he asked the American people to place in him.
Trust without accountability is not trust. It is submission.

_**(Piece continues)**_
The hearing carried unusual weight because Fauci's own contemporaneous diaries had already entered the public record. These were not memoirs written years later. They were private writings made while the crisis was unfolding. In the earliest weeks of 2020, they documented discussions among senior scientists as they evaluated competing possibilities for the virus's origin. The private record reflects uncertainty during a rapidly evolving public health emergency. Uncertainty is not the problem. Science begins with uncertainty. The question history will continue to examine is whether the uncertainty discussed privately was communicated with equal candor to the public whose lives were being fundamentally altered.
The diaries also reveal a striking personal contrast. Alongside entries chronicling one of the most consequential public health crises in modern history are references to Fauci's growing celebrity: bobbleheads manufactured in China, a brewery naming a beer after him, flattering media profiles, celebrity phone calls, and public campaigns celebrating his newfound fame. While millions of Americans struggled through isolation, uncertainty, and loss, Fauci devoted part of his private record to documenting his own ascent into celebrity. Death counts and personal elevation appear on the same pages. The juxtaposition is difficult to ignore.
The pandemic imposed costs that statistics alone will never capture. Patients died without family at their bedside under prolonged visitor restrictions. Children experienced profound educational disruption from extended school closures whose academic and mental health effects will be studied for years. Small businesses disappeared. Families were divided over mandates, schools, and public policy. Fauci did not personally write every hospital protocol or every local order, but he became the country's most influential public health voice. His guidance carried enormous weight, and institutions across America looked to him for direction.
The hearing unfolded against another extraordinary backdrop. President Biden had already issued Dr. Fauci a sweeping preemptive pardon covering years of official conduct. Supporters viewed it as protection against politically motivated prosecution. Critics viewed it as an unprecedented use of the pardon power. Whatever one's view, the pardon ensured the hearing would be judged not only by the questions that were asked, but by the answers that were never given.
History will examine far more than one Senate hearing. It will examine the evidence available at the time. It will examine the decisions made under extraordinary pressure. It will examine whether dissenting scientific views received fair consideration or were too readily dismissed. Above all, it will examine whether those entrusted with extraordinary authority demonstrated an equal commitment to extraordinary accountability.
That is the question Anthony Fauci was given an opportunity to answer.
He chose not to.
The press conferences will fade.
The television interviews will fade.
The slogans will fade.
The hearing will remain.
Anthony Fauci spent years asking the American people to trust his judgment. When Congress sought an accounting of that judgment under oath, he repeatedly declined to answer.
That is not the entire history of the pandemic.
But it will be part of Anthony Fauci's history.
In a constitutional republic, public trust is never permanent. It must be earned, sustained through transparency, and reinforced through accountability. The greater the authority entrusted to a public official, the greater the obligation to answer the people when they ask why.

body:
New Mexico deserves national leaders who understand that a healthy economy isn’t measured by how well billionaires are doing. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136394912/637298009/-272948131?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20260731_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTVjMDA1Ni0yYjhkLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yXyu_9SVVqMWxdfpzE6_zwezM0ZaX7_blA5OTnO-kUE=&emci=e8f20750-2b8d-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=ee5c0056-2b8d-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=252045)
---
Friend, New Mexico’s economy is powered by a lot of things: our small businesses, our entrepreneurs, our energy workers, our farmers, our artists. And it’s powered by the people who come here from all over the country and world to see and experience the Land of Enchantment and the riches it offers. But when families are stretched thin, travel is one of the first things they cut. They’re too worried about how to afford groceries, make their monthly housing payment, and keep their health care to think about vacations. They postpone weekend getaways. They stay closer to home. **And that has real consequences here in New Mexico.** _Nearly 100,000 New Mexicans depend on tourism and hospitality for their livelihoods._ From family-owned restaurants and local shops to hotel workers, tour guides, artists, and small business owners, countless families rely on a strong visitor economy. The economic chaos of the Trump administration is endangering all of that. A healthy economy isn’t measured by how well billionaires are doing. It’s measured by whether working families can get ahead and whether local businesses can thrive. _That’s what I’m fighting for in the Senate every day._ **And it’s why I’m working hard to elect Democrats who will put our families first.** **[If you’re with me, can you pitch in to support this critical work? --- Original Message ---
Peter, it’s nice to meet you.
I’m Sam Skardon, and I’m so deeply honored that Jermaine has asked me to join him on the ticket as our nominee for Lieutenant Governor.
In just a minute, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2] But first, I want to tell you about the four years that shaped everything I believe about public service.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
I was blessed to serve on the staff of Congressman John Lewis. More times than I can count, I had the honor of hearing him tell his life story, and every so often, I had the privilege of telling it too. Mr. Lewis and his colleagues truly built a New America through their sweat and blood.
From the sit-ins, to the Freedom Rides, to the march across the Edmund Pettus Bridge, let me tell you - his story has become a lifelong source of inspiration. It’s why my twin sons are named Lewis, after the Congressman, and Lawson, after Reverend Jim Lawson who taught Congressman Lewis and a generation of young organizers the discipline of non-violent resistance. I think about both of those men every day as I'm raising my boys in Charleston.
Now I'm running for Lieutenant Governor because Jermaine’s vision for a New South Carolina is one I’m willing to fight for too. Will you stand with us in this fight by chipping in any amount you can ahead of tonight’s end of month fundraising deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:GIVE $5 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=073126_2]

OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
The lesson I carried back home to South Carolina was to fight for the people who’ve been told to sit down and wait their turn. I’ve spent the past seven years in the city where I was raised, building and growing community loan funds to invest capital in small local businesses, clean energy projects, and affordable housing. And, of course, to make as much Good Trouble as possible.
Our opponent, Alan Wilson, and his family have spent 58 years in elected office, and they’ve done nothing but tell people to sit down and wait longer. He’s brought lawsuits to end patient protections from insurance companies, overturn elections, and interfered with corruption investigations. Jermaine and I are fighting for a New South Carolina that works for everyone - not just the sons of Congressmen.
Peter, we can get it done - but only if people like you stand beside us every step of the way. If you’re able, please make a donation today to help us build a winning campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
Thanks so much, Peter. Let’s make some Good Trouble.
Talk soon,
Sam

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. body:
Hi friend, Nikki here – I'll cut right to it:

Tonight is our end-of-month deadline, and with less than 100 days until Election Day, we are entering a critical phase.

Right now, we're facing a MAGA challenger who would be nothing more than another Trump mouthpiece in Washington. Republicans in Congress are acting with Trump's self-interest in mind – not for working people, seniors, veterans, farmers, or anyone not part of the billionaire class.

The consequences have been devastating. Health and food assistance slashed, tens of billions spent on a reckless war, and those left behind are struggling to make ends meet as gas and grocery prices rise.

American families have spent over $3,500 more since Trump took office last year. That's money most families don't have to spare – and our leaders should care enough to fix it.

Look – I’m not gonna sugarcoat this one.
**We _cannot_ run out of money** to fund and train ballot chasers at the worst possible time in this election cycle.
You’re one of Turning Point’s most dedicated supporters. When the rest of the list goes quiet, folks like you step up. That’s why I’m reaching out to you directly here.
Charlie Kirk built this movement from the ground up. He **_believed_** in the power of everyday patriots showing up, knocking on doors, and changing the direction of this country one conversation at a time.
We lost him, but we are **_still_** carrying his torch.
We need to train at least **[500 new ballot chasers next month](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e134085/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfanUtZW9tLWJjX2JyXzIwMjYwNzMx/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjA3MzE/LbmNsZ2t3dW9seQ/qP3V0bV90ZXJtPTIzMzc2X2Z0ZDEmYW1vdW50PTEwMA/gam0gXw/s6na3b26ba8)** and put them in key districts across the country.
If we hit that number, we have a real fighting chance at winning the midterms. We can keep “**democratic socialists** ” _AKA_ **_communists_** OUT of Congress.
But if we fail... we lose the majority. President Trump becomes a lame duck president. We get more of the same disastrous Biden-era policies. And for all practical purposes, the fight is over.
This is NOT theoretical. This is the crossroads.
We need patriots on the pavement right now. We need the funding to train them, equip them, and send them out before early voting begins.
**Help us keep Charlie’s mission alive.**
**[Every dollar makes a difference in training ballot chasers.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e134085/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfanUtZW9tLWJjX2JyXzIwMjYwNzMx/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjA3MzE/LbmNsZ2t3dW9seQ/qP3V0bV90ZXJtPTIzMzc2X2Z0ZDEmYW1vdW50PTEwMA/gam0gXw/s6na3b26ba8)**

We are running out of time to get the resources we urgently need to scale this operation. For Charlie. For Our Country. For the America we still believe in.

--- Original Message ---
Peter, it’s nice to meet you.
I’m Sam Skardon, and I’m so deeply honored that Jermaine has asked me to join him on the ticket as our nominee for Lieutenant Governor.
In just a minute, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2] But first, I want to tell you about the four years that shaped everything I believe about public service.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
I was blessed to serve on the staff of Congressman John Lewis. More times than I can count, I had the honor of hearing him tell his life story, and every so often, I had the privilege of telling it too. Mr. Lewis and his colleagues truly built a New America through their sweat and blood.
From the sit-ins, to the Freedom Rides, to the march across the Edmund Pettus Bridge, let me tell you - his story has become a lifelong source of inspiration. It’s why my twin sons are named Lewis, after the Congressman, and Lawson, after Reverend Jim Lawson who taught Congressman Lewis and a generation of young organizers the discipline of non-violent resistance. I think about both of those men every day as I'm raising my boys in Charleston.
Now I'm running for Lieutenant Governor because Jermaine’s vision for a New South Carolina is one I’m willing to fight for too. Will you stand with us in this fight by chipping in any amount you can ahead of tonight’s end of month fundraising deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:GIVE $5 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=073126_2]
GIVE $25 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=073126_2]
GIVE $75 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?express_lane=true&amount=75&refcode=073126_2]
GIVE $100 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode=073126_2]
GIVE $250 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?express_lane=true&amount=250&refcode=073126_2]
OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
The lesson I carried back home to South Carolina was to fight for the people who’ve been told to sit down and wait their turn. I’ve spent the past seven years in the city where I was raised, building and growing community loan funds to invest capital in small local businesses, clean energy projects, and affordable housing. And, of course, to make as much Good Trouble as possible.
Our opponent, Alan Wilson, and his family have spent 58 years in elected office, and they’ve done nothing but tell people to sit down and wait longer. He’s brought lawsuits to end patient protections from insurance companies, overturn elections, and interfered with corruption investigations. Jermaine and I are fighting for a New South Carolina that works for everyone - not just the sons of Congressmen.
Peter, we can get it done - but only if people like you stand beside us every step of the way. If you’re able, please make a donation today to help us build a winning campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]
Thanks so much, Peter. Let’s make some Good Trouble.
Talk soon,
Sam

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jermaine-july26?refcode=073126_2]I’m Jermaine Johnson, and I’m running to be the next Governor of South Carolina.
I wasn’t born into power — I fought my way into it. I'm not a career politician or a wealthy insider. I'm a husband, father, and fighter who knows what it’s like to grow up with nothing and still keep pushing forward.

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) says she is prepared to work through the Senate’s August recess “as long as it takes” to complete several major Republican priorities.

Her commitment comes after President Donald Trump called on Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-S.D.) to keep senators in Washington until they pass the SAVE America Act or eliminate the legislative filibuster.

In a statement to Yellowhammer News, Britt said she wants the Senate to complete a number of priorities before lawmakers leave Washington.

“I want to see the Senate pass SAVE America, pass the Russia-Iran Sanctions bill, confirm President Trump’s nominees, and prevent another Democratic shutdown before the August state work period,” Britt said.

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt praised the Senate’s 86-12 vote advancing Lindsey Graham’s sanctions bill Tuesday, calling it a show of American strength only hours after lawmakers gathered to honor the late South Carolina senator.

The bipartisan procedural vote moved the Senate forward on the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026. The legislation must still clear additional Senate votes before advancing to the House.

“What a day. The heaviness of the day is not lost on any of us,” Britt (R-Montgomery) said during a press conference following the vote.

“In typical Lindsey fashion, he found a way for us to vote on this bill right after we came back from celebrating his life.”

Britt said Graham told her and several colleagues that passing the legislation and sending it to President Donald Trump would be the most consequential accomplishment of his Senate career.

clean_body: | | | | | | | U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) says she is prepared to work through the Senate’s August recess “as long as it takes” to complete several major Republican priorities. Her commitment comes after President Donald Trump called on Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-S.D.) to keep senators in Washington until they pass the SAVE America Act or eliminate the legislative filibuster. In a statement to Yellowhammer News, Britt said she wants the Senate to complete a number of priorities before lawmakers leave Washington. “I want to see the Senate pass SAVE America, pass the Russia-Iran Sanctions bill, confirm President Trump’s nominees, and prevent another Democratic shutdown before the August state work period,” Britt said. | | U.S. Sen. Katie Britt praised the Senate’s 86-12 vote advancing Lindsey Graham’s sanctions bill Tuesday, calling it a show of American strength only hours after lawmakers gathered to honor the late South Carolina senator. The bipartisan procedural vote moved the Senate forward on the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026. The legislation must still clear additional Senate votes before advancing to the House. “What a day. The heaviness of the day is not lost on any of us,” Britt (R-Montgomery) said during a press conference following the vote. “In typical Lindsey fashion, he found a way for us to vote on this bill right after we came back from celebrating his life.” Britt said Graham told her and several colleagues that passing the legislation and sending it to President Donald Trump would be the most consequential accomplishment of his Senate career. | | A German soccer fan whose cross-country road trip during the 2026 FIFA World Cup captivated social media has received an invitation to return to Alabama from U.S. Sen. I’m glad I caught you before the weekend, Peter.
Tonight marks our July end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we’re still coming up a bit short of our online fundraising goal.
I hate to ask, but could you rush in a donation before midnight to help us meet this monthly benchmark?
Here’s a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2026**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136396899/637304022/-1060083271?refcode=em-7.31.26-all-d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjI1YzA5YS0zMThkLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Ak_PZj9HLS5eV_F6A3sLvV3WtfAC3EqVn8HJZpjQfc=)
When you work as a local meteorologist for twenty years, you become intimately familiar with the problems a community faces. In Congress, I’ve used that trust to advocate on important issues from protecting jobs in our district to the impacts of climate change.
With your support, I'm grateful to continue delivering for our district and, as always, I'm just grateful to have you by my side. I hope you'll stick with us through the rest of the cycle and then some.
Right now, the best way to do that is by donating to help keep this seat blue. Because in a district this close, every grassroots contribution will make a difference.
If you’re with me, chip in to give us a boost in this hyper-competitive race. Thank you, and have a wonderful weekend.
– Eric

body:
Featuring a papier-mâché squid

| | Dear David, There were days over the last year when this campaign felt a little lonely. An event with three people, hours on the phone, and no one picking up. But through it all, a core group of activists and organizers believed that people power could prevail against big money and business-as-usual politicians. In the last few weeks, itʼs become clear. Something special is happening in NH-01. Our events in every corner of the district routinely draw forty or fifty people, and the response to our appeals to help pay for our first mailer of the cycle exceeded our wildest expectations! [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/dWXbc2v8nXpE39pBFvZvvQ~~/AAUS1hA~/wml5YTr0WCaUfcIDHEr424IlRIATxf9BrZAJ4Bqqu3NhF4nbCQWl8sit-EKJDrplMmncNwWsGJmvmD-t_CUUcIrVwTtoQCl_CISR_w7XRE2jwMqUVkNQcvYVuWljrlJTShj964a-XPD89fhULopdbXbfW9BGRglua64xpQv2QBuT0w9Y5hVzkZtmQ2L1-7KEUUUSndL1ZVSbjyr2oMfImiLd2rOE7kO8Md9UuASWlW33wfw4Ix6MDw37GXICqNfp7iNI4LEClV1iVLXirIfXRA~~)
_Ericʼs view of our amazing event in Brentwood this afternoon!_ Someone asked me today what made me different from the other candidates in this race. I explained the policy differences: my support for Medicare for All, my advocacy for nuclear disarmament, and my insistence that we must abolish ICE and replace it with an immigration system built on human dignity and the rule of law. But what really distinguishes this campaign is not just the **_what,_** itʼs the **_how._** We built this campaign one conversation at a time. We built it by asking questions and listening to the answers. We connected with people, and they connected us to their friends and neighbors. What started with a small group of activists who believed we could organize to build power and make change grew into a grassroots network of 85 volunteer leaders and 1,000+ volunteers committed not just to winning on September 8th, but building a political organization finally capable of delivering real and lasting change for the working people of this district. **[And because of the generosity of people like you, we not only sent out our first mailer, weʼre already designing our second! clean_body: Featuring a papier-mâché squid | | | | Dear David, There were days over the last year when this campaign felt a little lonely. An event with three people, hours on the phone, and no one picking up. But through it all, a core group of activists and organizers believed that people power could prevail against big money and business-as-usual politicians. In the last few weeks, itʼs become clear. Something special is happening in NH-01. Our events in every corner of the district routinely draw forty or fifty people, and the response to our appeals to help pay for our first mailer of the cycle exceeded our wildest expectations! ~~ Ericʼs view of our amazing event in Brentwood this afternoon! Someone asked me today what made me different from the other candidates in this race. I explained the policy differences: my support for Medicare for All, my advocacy for nuclear disarmament, and my insistence that we must abolish ICE and replace it with an immigration system built on human dignity and the rule of law. But what really distinguishes this campaign is not just the what, itʼs the how. We built this campaign one conversation at a time. We built it by asking questions and listening to the answers. We connected with people, and they connected us to their friends and neighbors. What started with a small group of activists who believed we could organize to build power and make change grew into a grassroots network of 85 volunteer leaders and 1,000+ volunteers committed not just to winning on September 8th, but building a political organization finally capable of delivering real and lasting change for the working people of this district. ~~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: ** | | ~ ~ | ~ ~ | ~ ~~ Thank you for believing in what we can accomplish together. — Carleigh p.s. **Meet Evan Power:** | Evan Power has served as Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida since January 2024 and is a member of the Republican National Committee. Prior to becoming Chairman, Power led the Leon County Republican Party and served as Vice Chair of the Republican Party of Florida, earning a reputation as a disciplined organizer and effective leader in some of the state’s most challenging political terrain.

A graduate of Florida State University with a degree in Finance, Power began his political career working for U.S. Senator Marco Rubio and quickly became active in grassroots party leadership. In heavily Democratic Leon County, Power helped lead Republicans to historic victories — including Corey Simon’s landmark win for the Florida Senate, marking the first time since Reconstruction that Republicans captured the seat.

As Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida, Power partnered closely with President Donald J. Trump and his campaign to deliver historic statewide victories, including President Trump’s record-setting 13-point win in Florida in 2024. Under Power’s leadership, Florida Republicans expanded their voter registration advantage to more than 1.4 million voters, built the strongest grassroots operation in the nation, and cemented Florida’s status as the epicenter of the America First movement.

Power is a three-time delegate to the Republican National Convention, has twice been elected to serve on the Convention’s Rules and Order Committee, and proudly served as a member of the Electoral College for President Trump in 2024. name: Tracinski for Congress
subject: The Final Countdown
body:
The primary requires us to focus on the right issue.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8c05eea6f7c1/why-me-17293353?e=bd44204496)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/3QVTN5iWHNH?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)
| | | | | |
# The Final Countdown
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

[](https://us.list-manage.com/UMAguMGM47T?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

Cue the [classic 1986 song ](https://us.list-manage.com/11CkDibKf3C?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)from that Swedish hair metal band: It’s the final countdown to the Democratic primary for US Congress in the Fifth District.
I am pushing to make my final case, and some of the local media is finally beginning to provide some coverage. The ill-fated redistricting referendum sucked all the energy out of Virginia politics for a while, and I’ve been hearing that turnout for early voting in the primary is low. I expect there will be a lot of people who are just tuning in to this contest in the next couple of days—and I’m ready for them.
I’ll point you to two particularly good bits of press coverage—and ask you to send them on to as many people as possible.
_Cville Right Now_ posted an [excellent profile](https://us.list-manage.com/rRPGiYhygjq?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) that includes something I think will resonate with a lot of people
“Tracinski also hopes voters will appreciate that he’s a Washington outsider, not a career politician.
“‘I’m not somebody who wanted to be in politics or wants to be in politics,’ Tracinski said. ‘I’m doing this purely because I didn’t want to see our democracy go without a fight. And so I’m here to accomplish some key things to put the American system back together and make it function again. And then I’m going to be very happy to return home to a peaceful life.’”
I’m like that guy in the movie everyone’s talking about right now. I just want the chaos to be over so I can go back home. And I think a lot of other people would also like to be able to [put an oar on our shoulders](https://us.list-manage.com/140RcI0EzuW?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) and lead a quiet life again.
See [another profile](https://us.list-manage.com/tGKnBfmpP6b?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) in _Cardinal News_.
“His main campaign platform is to restore the Constitutional balance in Washington, DC, and rein in the power of ‘an out of control president.’
“‘I think there’s a big realignment going on in the national and even international political debate that the big alternative of our era is liberal democracy versus authoritarianism, and so we need to be standing up for liberal democracy and defending it,’ he said.
“He added that campaigning has given him hope, in an era of divisive politics, that the people he has met on campaign stops have been welcoming and interested in civil dialogue, regardless of their political affiliation.
“‘It’s been a lot more Norman Rockwell-esque than I had hoped for,’ he said. ‘What you see online is not necessarily representative of the American people.’
“His one-line summary of his campaign, he said, is that ‘The US Congress is a good idea and it would be nice if we had one.’”
_Cardinal News_ also sent out a long and interesting questionnaire, to which I gave some thoughtful and well-crafted answers—and apparently I was the only candidate to answer at all, so you can see my responses [here](https://us.list-manage.com/zJDn7OjYkx0?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) (scroll all the way down).
If you like what I’m saying, support my campaign. This is your **last chance** to help out before the primary this Tuesday, August 4, so please donate **now**.

### Why Not Just Vote for Tom?

Part of my goal for the last few days of the primary is to differentiate myself from my opponents and especially from the more established choice, Tom Perriello.
I recently posted a video taking that head-on: “[Why Not Just Vote for Tom?](https://us.list-manage.com/12h1gsAli2j?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)”
The main “why not” is from [another profile of the candidates](https://us.list-manage.com/UgYd7Po13bE?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) posted by a local TV station, which includes this response from Perriello on data centers.
“Where communities oppose data centers, I’m gonna fight like heck next to them to make sure those data centers don’t come in. And where a community wants a data center, I will fight equally as hard to make sure they get the best terms available.”
As I replied:
“Spoken like a true politician. Like data centers? He’s with you! Don’t like data centers? He’s also with you! All things to all people.
“I’m on record that after the primary, if Tom wins, I will support him over the Republican incumbent, John McGuire, who does not represent the people of the Fifth District and only answers to Donald Trump....
“My agenda is first and foremost about defending democracy and restoring the power of Congress. We need someone who believes in that cause, not just someone who will do it if the polls happen to look good at the moment.”
Similarly, I posted a [somewhat long response](https://us.list-manage.com/AEGV8hBXt5B?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) to the idea that AI is going to take all our jobs, a notion Perriello has been emphasizing. I don’t think it’s going to happen, and if we lose our jobs because of AI, it’s going to be because AI is a financial bubble, and when it collapses we will lose our jobs the old-fashioned way: by getting laid off in a recession.
But my main warning is that we should not get sidetracked.
“Instead of jumping on the bandwagon of these speculative scenarios, we should stay focused on the real big picture, which is the need to defend our democracy, rein in out-of-control executive power, and restore the power of the US Congress.”
If you want a Democratic candidate who actually [has a _plan_](https://us.list-manage.com/1BanYB5hIvi?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) for how we put Congress back on track, then I’m your man.

Help me get this message out by[ donating with ActBlue](https://us.list-manage.com/cFJwkKulbSp?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a). Even $100 or $200 can make a difference, especially in these crucial final days of the primary.

My opponent has the DeVos family writing her checks. This community has you.

| Tonight is our July deadline and I wanted to reach out myself...

Here's why this month matters to me personally.

Every day I'm in Washington, I'm thinking about West Michigan families who are stretching every dollar, paying more at the grocery store and gas pump, and wondering if their health care is going to be there when they need it. That's why I co-founded the Lowering Costs Caucus and that’s why I show up every single day to fight for Michiganders.

But here's the thing nobody tells you about being in the minority: you can fight as hard as you want, and the other side can still win the vote. The only way that changes is if we take back the House, and the path to that majority runs right through Michigan.

My opponent has the DeVos family writing her checks. This community has you.

body:
Peter, we're
just hours away from our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and I’m asking
one more time because the stakes couldn’t be higher.

Right now, young progressive candidates across the country are counting on
Leaders We Deserve to keep showing up for them.

Because the work we do isn’t just about endorsements — it’s about making
sure candidates who reject corporate money and represent a new generation
of leadership actually have the resources to compete and win.

I’ve seen the impact of this work firsthand.

Voters are excited to support someone who actually understands their
struggles and is willing to fight for their communities. They aren’t
looking for more politicians who protect the status quo. They’re looking
for leaders who will show up and deliver.

That’s why we’re investing in candidates who can change the face of
politics.

But our opponents have deep-pocketed donors, corporate PACs, and powerful
interests on their side. The only way we level the playing field is
through grassroots supporters like you.

These elections come down to the margins. And our support can be the
difference.

Before midnight, we’re working to hit our end-of-month goal so we can keep
supporting the candidates who are fighting to build a better future.
Candidates like Patrick Roath, who will face Democratic Congressman
Stephen Lynch in a September 1st Primary. Lynch has been in Congress for
almost 25 years and is the last remaining Democrat that voted against the
Affordable Care Act. He has voted 6 times to support ICE and is one of the
most conservative Democrats in Congress. With your support tonight, we
will have the resources we need to invest in races like Patrick’s during
these critical weeks before their primary elections.

In order to help us keep electing the next generation of leaders who can
win, will you make a contribution today before the deadline?

David

Below is the death threat I just received, sent by the Libertarian Party of New Hampshire to me and then amplified to their account of 100,000 followers.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
It’s clear what they want to do — incite someone to hurt me or my family.
I’m Christian Urrutia, the Democrat running for Congress in NH-01, America's most vulnerable open blue seat. I'm an economic populist and a first-generation Mexican-American son of immigrants. An Army officer. And someone who still believes in this country enough to fight for it.
To the far-right someone like me attaining elected office is an existential threat.
These type of extremists showed up to an event I spoke at waving Nazi flags trying to stop me from speaking (I gave my speech anyways). They send me messages telling me that my life may “abruptly come to an end.” They send me pictures of nooses.
Because they hate me, they hate us, and they hate our vision.
This isn’t just about me. It’s about whether we let hate and political violence take root here in America. Or whether we stand up and say no. You know where I stand. But I can’t do this alone.
If you can, please make a donation to help us beef up security for my staff and I so we can continue rolling with the punches. Whether it's $50, $20, or even just $10 it will have an outsized impact. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]

[] It’s clear what they want to do — incite someone to hurt me or my family. I’m Christian Urrutia, the Democrat running for Congress in NH-01, America's most vulnerable open blue seat. To the far-right someone like me attaining elected office is an existential threat. These type of extremists showed up to an event I spoke at waving Nazi flags trying to stop me from speaking (I gave my speech anyways). They send me messages telling me that my life may “abruptly come to an end.” They send me pictures of nooses. Because they hate me, they hate us, and they hate our vision. This isn’t just about me. A longer note on the state of campaign funding in our country – and why we are counting on your help to elect Democrats + turn things around.
#
Peter,
Across the country right now, there are incredible Democratic candidates running for office — up and down the entire ballot, in every single state.
They’ve got organizers knocking on doors. Volunteers making calls. These candidates are tirelessly showing up for their communities day after day.
The energy is there. The people are there.
**Money is the factor that is too often missing.**
**[ELECT DEMOCRATS: CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/107001?refcode=em20260731-10744&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10744%2E614464%2ECyLK54)**
Here's the reality we’re facing right now: **The Republican Party is propped up by a network of billionaires and special interest groups who can write massive checks without giving it a second thought.** Dark money flows freely – funding attack ads, voter suppression efforts, and GOP candidates who answer to their donors instead of the people they were elected to serve.
**Democrats are doing things differently.** Our power comes from real people like you – grassroots donors who give what they can, when they can, because they believe that our country can do better than it’s doing right now.
And that matters enormously. But it also means we face hard choices.
**Right now, we’re working to support Democratic candidates in all 50 states.**
We all know there is no shortage of fights worth having – and no shortage of dedicated leaders who are ready to have them. But without adequate resources, we are forced to make impossible decisions about where to invest, which races to prioritize, and which communities we simply cannot reach.
**Every state matters. Every election matters. Every constituent matters.**

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

Hamas Disarmament Deal
President Trump announced Thursday that his Board of Peace secured an agreement for the [complete disarmament](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0L_O3CAQBPCnwR0nwPg4FxRp3H1pU1p7sLGJ-Cd2_d3rR84jpB_9NDO_vvYvSDnV4ycU9Ilojy3uUDnxuEonrMBtECFfnc62G2WeUjk56x0Cp2_cLUzRL0a_fr8m9Nq9lsXq1anp9FYZu0YXzayD0-pp1gUjvhfnHL4tzFPyt6fcrM28GLs-nApWaePWt3Kv4FBYdfUIjI9UKUWk0FrvLSdOgR5tHFP2J3MnMf8QZhNm-3MR84kVP_QIrQizfdrIUZitpBgzSgRiYbY-8AYry39DJdTarhqQZGilZ2SUMRGMAuUOnVCAJNQoIWfZ-MQhYRSM8hjt6jQNH_sn5Zzo6YRVR4GU7wIT_--r3978DQAA__85OI01) of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza, calling it a monumental step toward lasting peace. Mediated by Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey, the framework will proceed in [structured phases](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0L2unDAUBOCnMZ2RsQ2GwkUauk2bEp21D3Ak_CPbuyR5-mhT3Ae47UgzI32_HtsD6KJ4_ISAlmrdfPIbxEatvEKuGKGlUiu2V65n2qSQExeGq2ED1-iNm4bO21EO8z53aAczj6MeFiO606LblTJKunECUOgWoycx-B130LAb1ZH97AmjBqlGqZfeCKfFIM3yFGZ2BpkWr-yhYU-xksfqUso5XdTI1T6Vo7vs2VquTP1gcmVyve-7v6GeFI-WIv6GQBFL71Jgcv003R8m1z0VpCPyr0BPRigpmFyfCYrnaecZwSGHoyAGjI17qlACPyFA5Qf8Bf6fiMm1K9bnm66L6mSYFkcAuj6XXfsu6dvKfwEAAP__biiKZg), with Israeli forces withdrawing as decommissioning is verified and an international force partnering with a new Palestinian police force. Officials called the pact the product of an [eight-month effort](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0EGynCAQxvHT4A4LEQddsMiG3cs2S6sHerRTCJSNYyWnT02O8C7w_er7__pav4AS5e0nHOiIeY0lrpAbtfM6KmOGVk5mbFflvaxa6YdUVo7DCqHRG1cDXXSTHubX3KEb7DxNZlis6nb3eo0xWjM-cV4g2LBYi-ahYH7iA8d56sh99pQdBz1O2iy9VcGoQdvlqewcLAqjrhqhYU-ZKSKHUmotiRoF7su5dcntrVUW4w-hvdD-vu_-Bt4pb63kRgdyH8ohtM94s9D-Iwrtf19JaD8qoX0sGVKU_w9Lhj8snwXOKCtCQHkihB2jjAhJRmI4D7nDASw3-AtC--50sd6UEvHDCqO2Ayh9zK59N-jb6X8BAAD__6ENiLA) to implement Trump's 20-point plan. Israel remains skeptical Hamas will actually surrender its weapons and tunnels, and officials cautioned the deal is conditions-based rather than trust-based, with progress expected within a month. Trump vowed the October 7 threat "will NOT be allowed to rebuild," framing the agreement as the biggest milestone yet in his push to rebuild Gaza under a new Palestinian government. ★★★

John Cornyn and Thom Tillis blocked a Judiciary Committee vote over the administration's anti-weaponization fund. Trump praised Blanche as a "star" who stays as acting attorney general regardless. This is how they test our democracy:
First, it’s a letter.
Then it’s a threat.
Then it’s voter data demanded under pressure.
That’s exactly what the Trump Administration is trying to do.
Tonight at midnight is our end-of-month fundraising deadline. And this deadline matters because it’s not just about dollars — it’s about momentum. Please make a campaign donation before the deadline. We’re still about $2,150 shy of our goal – and I’m counting on you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260731em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260731em]
Trump and his allies are looking for new ways to get at voter rolls, intimidate states, and undermine trust in elections. They’re testing who will fold — and who will fight.
In Oregon, we choose to fight.
We’ve set a clear goal: raise $5,000 by midnight tonight to show that Oregonians are united, organized, and ready to defend our democracy before it’s under siege here.
If you’ve been waiting to step in, this is the moment. A contribution in these final hours helps us stay on offense — protecting voters and ensuring no one bullies our state into surrendering its election infrastructure.
This is our first major test of 2026. Let’s send a message that Oregon won’t be intimidated.
Please chip in before midnight and help us close January strong. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260731em]
Thank you,
Tobias Read
